data.description:
Submittal Clerk

  • Work Type: Full-time.

  • Schedule: Standard US business hours, with occasional overtime and weekend work required based on bid schedules and workload demands.

  • Location: 100% Remote.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly organized and specialized administrative professional to serve as a Submittal Clerk. Operating in the critical space between pre-construction and operations, you will be responsible for generating, organizing, and tracking technical product data and comprehensive submittal packages. By meticulously managing the technical document approval process, you will prevent ordering delays and ensure that all proposed materials match project specifications and receive design team approval prior to procurement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Specification Review: Review project specifications and contract documents to precisely identify all required submittals, LEED documentation, warranties, and closeout requirements.

  • Package Assembly: Gather product data sheets, Safety Data Sheets (SDS), color charts, and testing data from manufacturers to assemble comprehensive and accurate submittal packages.

  • Tracking & Follow-Up: Log all outgoing submittals, rigorously track review times, and follow up proactively with General Contractors (GCs) or Architects regarding "Revise and Resubmit" or "Approved as Noted" statuses.

  • Internal Distribution: Distribute approved submittals to the project management and purchasing teams to facilitate accurate, timely material ordering.

  • Project Closeout: Assist in compiling Operations and Maintenance (O&M) manuals and warranty documentation at project completion.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Experience: 1–3 years of professional experience in construction administration, document control, or project engineering.

  • Technical Proficiency: Demonstrated ability to read and navigate construction specifications (specifically Division 7 and Division 8). Familiarity with construction management software (e.g., Procore) for executing submittal workflows.

  • Core Competencies: High attention to detail, accuracy, and rigorous documentation practices. Effective written and verbal communication skills. Must be able to pass a pre-employment screening.

  • Remote Infrastructure: Must have a dedicated, noise-free home office setup equipped with a reliable, high-speed internet connection and a backup power source.

Benefits of Working for Hyre

  • Performance-based raises.

  • Minimum 5 days off annually (paid or unpaid based on client terms).

  • Annual cost-of-living adjustments at your one-year anniversary.

Apply directly on RemoteJobs.org: https://remotejobs.org/remote-jobs/submittal-clerk-hyre

data.title: Integration/Middleware Engineer
data.description:
Applications for this position will be accepted through 11/9/26 Koniag IT Systems, LLC a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking an Integration/Middleware Engineer to support KITS and our government customer. The position is remote. This position requires the candidate to be able to obtain a Public Trust.

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, flexible spending accounts, commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement. The Integration/Middleware Engineer provides advanced technical engineering support for CLIENT's enterprise integration platforms, middleware environments, API management services, and data pipeline infrastructure. This individual brings deep integration engineering expertise to the design, build, operation, and sustainment of CLIENT's enterprise integration environment.

This role is focused specifically on integration engineering and middleware platform operations — the technical discipline of connecting enterprise systems, automating data flows, managing APIs, and ensuring reliable, secure, and performant integration services across CLIENT's on-premises and cloud application portfolio. The Integration / Middleware Engineer works at the platform and architecture level, designing and building integration solutions that enable CLIENT's enterprise applications to communicate and operate effectively as a cohesive enterprise environment.

This individual must demonstrate deep hands-on expertise in enterprise integration platforms, middleware technologies, API management, and data pipeline engineering, with the ability to independently design, build, and troubleshoot complex integrations in a federal enterprise environment that spans on-premises infrastructure, AWS, and Microsoft Azure Government.

Key Responsibilities:

Integration Platform Engineering & Operations:

  • Design, build, configure, and maintain CLIENT's enterprise integration platform and middleware environments, ensuring reliable, secure, and well-performing data flows and system integrations
  • Engineer and maintain integration interfaces, data pipelines, message queues, and event-driven integration workflows across CLIENT's enterprise application portfolio
  • Develop and maintain integration platform configurations, connection management settings, and interface administration procedures
  • Monitor integration platform health, performance, and error rates using Government-provided monitoring tools and dashboards
  • Detect, diagnose, and resolve integration failures, data pipeline errors, and middleware incidents independently for moderately complex issues
  • Escalate complex or cross-domain integration incidents to the Senior Application Operations Engineer or Applications & Integration Lead as appropriate
  • Evaluate integration platform performance and implement engineering improvements that enhance reliability, throughput, and operational efficiency

API Management Engineering:

  • Design, build, and maintain API configurations, policies, and security controls in CLIENT's enterprise API management platform
  • Engineer API gateway configurations, including rate limiting, authentication, authorization, and traffic management policies
  • Develop and maintain API documentation, including endpoint specifications, data schemas, and integration guides
  • Monitor API performance, availability, and security posture, taking proactive action to address issues and prevent service degradation
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex API connectivity, performance, and security issues independently
  • Support API lifecycle management activities, including versioning, deprecation, and retirement of API endpoints
  • Maintain accurate API inventory, endpoint configuration records, and security policy documentation

Middleware Configuration & Administration:

  • Administer and maintain CLIENT's middleware platforms, including message brokers, enterprise service buses, and event streaming platforms as applicable
  • Engineer middleware configurations, including topic management, queue administration, consumer group management, and message routing rules
  • Monitor middleware platform health and performance, taking proactive action to address capacity, performance, and availability issues
  • Support middleware platform upgrades, patching, and version management activities in accordance with ITIL 4 change management practices
  • Develop and maintain middleware administration runbooks, configuration standards, and operational procedures
  • Coordinate with the Infrastructure and Platform Operations team on middleware platform infrastructure requirements and capacity planning

Integration Security Engineering:

  • Engineer integration security configurations aligned with FISMA, NIST SP 800-53, FedRAMP, and CLIENT cybersecurity policies
  • Implement secure integration patterns, including encrypted data transmission, certificate management, OAuth 2.0 / SAML authentication, and API security controls
  • Support Zero Trust Architecture implementation across integration platforms in coordination with the Microsoft Infrastructure and Network teams
  • Conduct integration security engineering reviews and provide recommendations for improving CLIENT's integration security posture
  • Manage integration platform certificates, credentials, and secrets in accordance with CLIENT security and key management requirements
  • Support security assessment activities and audit evidence collection for integration platforms and API management services

Cloud Integration Engineering:

  • Engineer and maintain integrations between CLIENT's on-premises systems and cloud environments, including AWS commercial, AWS GovCloud, Microsoft Azure Government, and Microsoft 365
  • Support Azure Integration Services engineering, including Logic Apps, Service Bus, Event Grid, and API Management configurations
  • Coordinate with the Microsoft Infrastructure Administrator (Senior) and Infrastructure and Platform Operations team on cloud integration requirements and architecture
  • Engineer and maintain cloud-based data pipeline workflows and event-driven integration patterns
  • Support FedRAMP compliance for cloud-based integration services and API management platforms
  • Maintain accurate cloud integration architecture documentation and configuration records

Integration Testing & Quality Assurance:

  • Develop and execute integration test plans, test cases, and validation procedures for new and modified integration interfaces
  • Conduct integration regression testing to validate that platform changes do not introduce failures or performance degradation
  • Support end-to-end integration testing for application releases and major platform changes
  • Maintain accurate integration test documentation, test results, and defect records in the Government ITSM platform
  • Coordinate with application teams and the Senior Application Operations Engineer on integration test planning and execution
  • Provide integration test results and quality assurance data to support release readiness reviews

Required Qualifications:

Experience:

  • Minimum 4–6 years of hands-on enterprise integration engineering and middleware operations experience
  • Demonstrated experience designing, building, and operating enterprise integration platforms and middleware at scale
  • Proven experience with API management platform engineering and API security configuration
  • Experience with data pipeline design and engineering for enterprise application environments
  • Demonstrated experience with cloud integration engineering, including Azure Integration Services or equivalent AWS integration services
  • Experience in a Federal or private-sector enterprise environment of comparable scale, complexity, and security posture
  • Proven ability to independently resolve complex integration and middleware engineering problems
  • Familiarity with FedRAMP-authorized integration platforms and Federal integration security requirements
  • Experience implementing integration security controls aligned with NIST SP 800-53

Technical Expertise:

• Expert-level proficiency in:

  • Enterprise integration platform engineering (e.g., MuleSoft Anypoint, Dell Boomi, Azure Integration Services, IBM MQ, or equivalent)
  • API management platform engineering and security configuration (e.g., Azure API Management, MuleSoft API Gateway, AWS API Gateway)
  • Middleware administration (e.g., message brokers, enterprise service buses, event streaming platforms)
  • Data pipeline design, engineering, and operations
  • Integration security engineering (OAuth 2.0, SAML, TLS/SSL, certificate management)
  • REST and SOAP API design, development, and troubleshooting
  • Cloud integration engineering (Azure Logic Apps, Service Bus, Event Grid, AWS EventBridge, or equivalent)

• Strong working knowledge of:

  • Microsoft 365 and Azure Government integration patterns
  • JSON, XML, and data transformation technologies (e.g., XSLT, DataWeave, or equivalent)
  • Integration testing methodologies and tools
  • CI/CD pipeline concepts relevant to integration deployments
  • FedRAMP requirements for cloud-based integration platforms
  • Zero Trust Architecture principles as applied to integration security
  • NIST SP 800-53 security controls for integration platforms
  • ITSM platforms (e.g., ServiceNow)
  • ITIL 4 change, incident, and release management practices
  • Scripting and automation (e.g., PowerShell, Python, or equivalent)

Additional preferred certifications:

  • MuleSoft Certified Developer – Level 1 or Level 2
  • MuleSoft Certified Integration Architect
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Integration Services Specialty
  • AWS Certified Developer – Associate
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior experience supporting Federal civilian agency enterprise integration environments
  • Familiarity with CLIENT or similar agency integration platforms and application portfolios
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum delivery models in an integration engineering context
  • Experience with event-driven architecture and event streaming platforms (e.g., Apache Kafka, Azure Event Hubs)
  • Demonstrated experience with integration observability tools and platforms (e.g., Dynatrace, Splunk, Azure Monitor)
  • Experience supporting FISMA assessment and authorization activities for integration platforms
  • Experience with GraphQL API design and management
  • Experience with containerized integration deployments (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift)

We are committed to equal employment opportunity in all decisions related to employment, promotion, wages, benefits, and all other privileges, terms, and conditions of employment. The company is dedicated to seeking all qualified applicants. If you require an accommodation to navigate or apply for a position on our website, please get in touch with Heaven Wood via e-mail at or by calling 703-488-9377 to request accommodations.

data.title: Ingeniero Forense Estructural (Remoto / Bilingüe)
data.description:
Este es un puesto de trabajo remoto.

Buscamos unEspecialista en Patología Estructuralque actúe como nuestro "cerebro consultor". Tu misión principal será diagnosticar patologías en edificaciones a distancia y diseñar planes de rehabilitación, trabajando junto al equipo operativo en campo. Este rol no es para inspectores de obra tradicionales; está diseñado para un experto en cálculo estructural.

  • Diagnosticar causas raíz (flexión, cortante, carbonatación, asentamientos) utilizando evidencia limitada y remota (fotografías, reportes).
  • Diseñar soluciones de refuerzo estructural innovadoras y viables para la construcción en la vida real.
  • Traducir y comunicar diagnósticos técnicos complejos a clientes que no son ingenieros.
  • Liderar investigaciones técnicas con alta autonomía y pensamiento lateral para resolver "casos raros".

Requirements

  • Experiencia: Mínimo 2 años comprobables estrictamente en ingeniería estructural (si tu experiencia no es exclusiva en patologías, se exigirá un número mayor de años generales).
  • Idioma (Descartatorio): Inglés Técnico Operativo Avanzado para interpretar planos y normativas americanas a diario.
  • Conocimiento Técnico (Dominio en al menos 3): Normativa americana (ACI 364, ASCE 11), diseño de refuerzo (FRP, micropilotes), cimentaciones, peritajes o análisis de causa raíz.
  • Portafolio Obligatorio: Dossier forense verificable mostrando magnitud, alcance de tu participación y cliente en proyectos reales de patología (se aceptan datos censurados bajo NDA).
  • Validación de Inglés Obligatoria: Evidencia técnica comprobable de redacción y lectura fluida de reportes bajo códigos de EE. UU.

Benefits

  • Modalidad 100% remota:Flexibilidad total para ejercer tu labor de manera virtual desde cualquier ubicación.

  • Pagos puntuales en dólares (USD): Compensación segura, con la garantía y tranquilidad de recibir tus pagos siempre a tiempo.

data.title: Sr IAM Software Engineer
data.description:
Las Vegas, Nevada

The SHOW comes alive at MGM Resorts International

Have you ever wondered what it would be like to work in a place full of excitement, diversity, and entertainment? Are you enthusiastic about being a team player in one of the most fascinating industries in the world? At MGM Resorts, we seek individuals like YOU to create unique and show-stopping experiences for our guests.

THE JOB:
The Senior Software Engineer, Identity and Access Management (IAM), will design, build, and operate enterprise IAM solutions across cloud and on-prem environments, including Microsoft Entra ID, AWS Identity Center, and GCP IAM. This hands-on role serves as a technical subject matter expert for identity lifecycle management, RBAC, PIM/PAM, MFA, SSO, and Zero Trust access controls (e.g., Conditional Access andpasswordless). You will implement secure integrations using standards such as SAML, OAuth 2.0/OIDC (OpenID Connect), LDAP, Kerberos, NTLM, and SCIM, and drive automation through APIs and scripting. The ideal candidate has experience with platforms such as SailPoint, BeyondTrust, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), and Active Directory, and partners effectively with engineering and governance teams to deliver resilient, audit-ready services.

THE DAY-TO-DAY:

  • Define and execute IAM strategy aligned with business and security goals.

  • Architect, build, test, deploy, and monitor IAM services across cloud and on-prem.

  • Gather and document requirements; align solutions with stakeholders.

  • Establish IAM policies, standards, and processes to enforce best practices and reduce risk.

  • Collaborate with Engineering, Compliance, IT, and HR to deliver on the IAM roadmap.

  • Act as technical lead/SME, providing guidance, escalation support, and driving adoption.

  • Automate provisioning and access workflows (JML), deliver integrations, and own service health, monitoring, incident response, and audit support (SOX, PCI, MICS).

THE IDEAL CANDIDATE:

  • Bachelor’s (or equivalent) with 5+ years in IAM and software engineering.

  • Experience designing and deploying IAM solutions using platforms like SailPoint, BeyondTrust, and Entra ID (Azure AD).

  • Strong knowledge of authentication/authorization standards (SAML, OAuth 2.0, OIDC) and Zero Trust concepts.

  • Hands-on experience with Entra ID (hybrid, Conditional Access), AWS Identity Center, and GCP IAM.

  • Proficiency in SQL, PowerShell/Python, REST APIs, and automation/integration patterns (JML lifecycle).

  • Experience with DevOps/CI-CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, Ansible), IaC (Terraform), and service platforms (ServiceNow).

  • Strong troubleshooting skills; familiarity with Oracle identity governance, regulated environments (SOX, PCI, MICS), MFA/passwordless (FIDO2), and SSO integrations.

THE PERKS & BENEFITS:

  • Wellness incentive programs to help you stay healthy physically and mentally

  • Access to company hotel, food and beverage, retail, and entertainment discounts as well as discounts with company partners on things like travel, electronics, online shopping, and more

  • Free meals in our employee dining room

  • Free parking

  • Health & Income Protection benefits (for eligible employees)

Bright Vision Technologies is a forward-thinking software development company dedicated to building innovative solutions that help businesses automate and optimize their operations. We leverage cutting-edge technologies to create scalable, secure, and user-friendly applications.

As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a skilled SAP ABAP Programmer to join our dynamic team and contribute to our mission of transforming business processes through technology.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: SAP ABAP Programmer
Location: 100% Remote (Continental United States)
Position Type: In-house Bright Vision Technologies SOW engagement (no third-party client or vendor)
Salary: $100K - $150K
Experience: 5+ years

Employment Terms & Visa Policy
This is a 100% remote, full-time, direct W2 position with Bright Vision Technologies.
This role is part of Bright Vision Technologies’ in-house Statement of Work (SOW) engagement. The client, end customer, and employer for this position is Bright Vision Technologies — there is no third-party client, vendor, or implementation partner involved.
We do not engage in C2C, 1099, or third-party arrangements for this role.

Candidates must be willing to work directly as a full-time W2 employee of Bright Vision Technologies and contribute to our in-house SOW deliverables.
No new H1B sponsorship is available for this role.

However, candidates who are currently on a valid H1B visa and require a transfer are welcome to apply. We will support H1B transfers for qualified candidates.
For every role, a technical coding assessment is mandatory. Please apply only if you are confident in your technical abilities and hands-on experience.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced SAP ABAP Programmer with strong S/4HANA expertise to design, develop, and support custom enhancements, integrations, and reports within large enterprise SAP landscapes. This role spans the full development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, technical design, hands-on coding, unit testing, performance tuning, and post-go-live support in close collaboration with functional consultants and business stakeholders. The ideal candidate will combine deep ABAP expertise — including core ABAP, ABAP OO, CDS views, AMDPs, and OData — with a strong understanding of S/4HANA architecture, Fiori integration, and clean-core principles that minimize technical debt and ease future upgrades.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop custom ABAP programs, enhancements, BAPIs, BADIs, user exits, and interfaces within SAP S/4HANA environments, following clean-core and modification-free principles wherever possible.
  • Build performant CDS views, AMDPs, and HANA-optimized ABAP code that leverages code pushdown and takes full advantage of S/4HANA’s in-memory architecture.
  • Develop and consume OData services and RESTful APIs to support Fiori applications and integrations with non-SAP systems.
  • Implement SAP Gateway services, including service registration, modeling, and lifecycle management.
  • Design and develop classical and interactive ALV reports, smart forms, Adobe forms, and modern Fiori-aligned output channels.
  • Build and maintain integration interfaces using IDocs, RFC, BAPI, Web Services, and the SAP API Hub.
  • Perform technical analysis of business requirements in collaboration with functional consultants, and translate them into well-documented technical designs.
  • Conduct thorough unit testing, support functional and integration testing, and resolve defects raised during UAT and post-go-live hypercare.
  • Lead performance tuning of ABAP code, SQL queries, and database access patterns, including the use of SAT, ST05, and HANA-specific diagnostic tools.
  • Support S/4HANA upgrades, system conversions, and code remediation activities, including SCMON / UPL analysis and clean-core readiness assessments.
  • Implement security best practices in custom developments, including authority checks, secure data handling, and compliance with internal SAP governance.
  • Document technical specifications, code reviews, and operational procedures in line with enterprise SAP standards.
  • Mentor junior ABAP developers and act as a technical reference within the SAP team.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of professional ABAP development experience, with significant time on S/4HANA.
  • Strong hands-on expertise with ABAP OO, CDS views, AMDPs, and HANA-optimized ABAP.
  • Solid experience building OData services and integrating with Fiori applications.
  • Hands-on experience with enhancement frameworks (BADIs, user exits, implicit/explicit enhancements).
  • Strong experience with integration technologies (IDoc, RFC, BAPI, Web Services).
  • Solid understanding of SAP module data structures, including FI/CO, SD, MM, or PP, depending on the project area.
  • Experience with performance tuning tools (SAT, ST05) and HANA diagnostic tools.
  • Familiarity with SAP Solution Manager, ChaRM, and SAP transport management.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with S/4HANA system conversions or greenfield implementations.
  • Exposure to SAP BTP, ABAP RAP (RESTful ABAP Programming Model), or steampunk.
  • Hands-on experience with Fiori/UI5 development.
  • Familiarity with SAP CPI / Integration Suite.
  • SAP-certified ABAP developer credentials.

data.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Agentic Platform
data.description:
Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

About North North is Cohere's cutting-edge AI workspace platform, designed to revolutionize the way enterprises utilize AI. It offers a secure and customizable environment, allowing companies to deploy AI while maintaining control over sensitive data. North integrates seamlessly with existing workflows, providing a trusted platform that connects AI agents with workplace tools and applications.

Why this role?

This role offers a unique opportunity to shape how enterprises harness the power of AI in real-world applications. As a bridge between our core North product and our clients’ engineering teams, you’ll be at the forefront of solving complex problems and securely integrating AI into critical sectors such as finance, healthcare, and telecommunications.

We’re looking for Software Engineers with Applied AI experience who can own the design, build, and deployment of agentic workflows powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), from early prototypes to production-grade AI agents, to deliver concrete business value in enterprise workflows. You’ll work closely with customers on real-world business problems, often building first-of-their-kind agent workflows that integrate LLMs with tools, APIs, and data sources. While our pace is startup-fast, the bar is enterprise-high: agents must be reliable, observable, safe, and auditable from day one.

Note: between 20 - 40% travel anticipated. In This Role, You Will
  • Work closely with our enterprise customers to translate high-value, ambiguous business problems into well-framed agentic workflows with clear success criteria and evaluation methodologies
  • Lead the design, build, and delivery of LLM-powered agents that reason, plan, and act across tools, APIs, and sensitive enterprise data sources, with enterprise-grade reliability and performance
  • Build and ship features for North, our AI workspace platform, working across the full product lifecycle from conceptualization through production
  • Take ownership of scoping and shaping use cases end-to-end, flexing into whatever technical area the problem demands (including frontend) to drive the most effective solution
  • Contribute to shared frameworks and patterns that enable consistent, high-quality delivery across customers and teams
  • Drive clarity in ambiguous situations, build alignment, and raise engineering quality across the organization
  • Travel up to 20–40% to work on-site with customers and partners
You May Be a Good Fit If
  • You have hands-on experience building and deploying production-grade software in Python; you write clean, testable, observable, scalable code
  • You've built and deployed highly performant RAG and agentic applications, including agents that plan and execute multi-step tasks using patterns like ReAct or Plan-and-Execute
  • You're deeply familiar with the LLM stack: frontier models, vector databases, and orchestration frameworks
  • You have a proven ability to build robust evaluation frameworks, moving well beyond trial and error, to measure agent accuracy, safety, and latency
  • You’re experienced working directly with customers and can lead technical discussions with enterprise stakeholders, translating ambiguous business needs into concrete technical specs
  • You have experience owning the full scope of a use case end-to-end
  • You thrive in fast-paced and ambiguous environments and can execute well even when priorities are shifting
It's a Bonus If You Have
  • Experience setting architectural standards for AI and agentic systems across distributed teams
  • Experience flexing into unfamiliar technical areas, such as frontend, when the problem calls for it
  • Exposure to regulated or sensitive industry environments (finance, healthcare, telecoms)
  • Experience with enterprise security, compliance, or auditability requirements for AI systems
Full-Time Employees At Cohere Enjoy These Perks

At IMP we help Multi-Academy Trusts (MATs) take control of their finances. Our MAT-first software is built by people who know the sector inside out. More than half of all MATs in the UK already use IMP to plan with confidence, simplify complex processes and make smarter decisions.

We’re proud to be independent, founder-led and growing fast. Alongside our award-winning products, we’ve built a culture we’re equally proud of. We are ranked as one of the UK’s Top 25 Great Places to Work for mid-sized companies. Respect, collaboration and personal growth sit at the heart of how we work. You’ll find flexibility, support and opportunities to develop here, alongside regular team socials and funded CPD.

Partnerships

Delivery

People

Quality & Engineering Practice

Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. By joining us in this role, you will be responsible for managing and leading the team across all people-related matters and engineering delivery and efficiency. Our eCommerce division has grown rapidly, now exceeding 50 engineers. To support our scaling goals, we’re looking for a leader who can combine strong technical expertise with people management skills, helping teams perform at their best while maintaining operational excellence.

data.description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

Lead IT Architect

Job Summary

The Lead IT Architect is responsible for defining and driving technology strategy, architectural direction, AI-enabled engineering transformation, and solution design across a Value Stream and its Agile Release Train (ART). This role owns the architectural runway for the ART, ensuring teams have the technical direction, architecture patterns, technical enablers, architectural context, and future-state designs needed to deliver scalable, secure, resilient, and maintainable solutions.

Working closely with Engineering, Product Management, Enterprise Architecture, Security, Delivery Leadership, Shared Services organizations, and the CoverMyMeds AI Enablement team, this individual proactively identifies technology opportunities, architectural risks, modernization initiatives, and emerging engineering patterns before they impact delivery.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with strong leadership skills, communications skills, and a passion for architectural excellence, agentic engineering, AI-assisted software delivery, enterprise-scale software development, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

Architectural Runway & Value Stream Leadership

  • Plan the architectural runway for an Agile Release Train (ART), proactively defining solution approaches, technical enablers, architecture patterns, dependencies, and future-state designs that enable teams across the Value Stream to deliver effectively at scale.
  • Partner with Product Management, Engineering Leadership, and Enterprise Architecture to ensure upcoming features, epics, and initiatives have a clear architectural path prior to implementation.
  • Develop and maintain technology and architecture roadmaps that support Value Stream objectives while balancing scalability, technical debt reduction, reliability, security, compliance, and delivery velocity.
  • Identify capability gaps, modernization opportunities, architectural risks, and cross-team dependencies before they become delivery impediments.
  • Establish architectural direction across multiple teams and applications, ensuring alignment on technology strategy and implementation approaches.
  • Ensure teams are never waiting on architecture guidance, standards, patterns, technical decisions, architecture artifacts, or technical enablers required to execute delivery commitments.

AI & Agentic Engineering Leadership

  • Partner with the CoverMyMeds AI Enablement team to evaluate, adopt, and operationalize AI-assisted software delivery practices across the ART.
  • Serve as the primary architecture lead for AI adoption within the Value Stream, driving practical implementation of approved AI capabilities, tools, patterns, and engineering practices.
  • Identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity, software quality, documentation, testing, knowledge management, architecture governance, operational support, and delivery effectiveness through AI-enabled workflows and automation.
  • Develop adoption roadmaps and implementation plans that accelerate AI-assisted software delivery across engineering teams.
  • Partner with Engineering Managers, Technical Leads, and development teams to increase adoption of AI-assisted development practices using platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude, GitHub Copilot, and future enterprise-supported solutions.
  • Define and maintain the architectural context, Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), repository standards, architecture artifacts, and knowledge-management practices required to effectively support agentic engineering.
  • Drive adoption of architecture-as-code, AI-assisted documentation, automated architecture validation, and agent-enabled engineering workflows.
  • Collaborate with the AI Enablement team to evaluate emerging agentic engineering capabilities and determine how they can be safely and effectively operationalized within the Value Stream.
  • Serve as a champion for modern engineering practices and help teams evolve how software is designed, built, tested, documented, and supported.

Solution Architecture & Technical Design

  • Lead the design of scalable, secure, resilient, and maintainable enterprise solutions.
  • Create detailed architecture artifacts including system context diagrams, solution architecture diagrams, integration diagrams, deployment topologies, sequence diagrams, data flow diagrams, domain models, reference architectures, and implementation-ready design materials.
  • Translate business and product objectives into actionable technical designs that can be executed consistently across multiple delivery teams.
  • Evaluate architectural alternatives and recommend solutions based on business, operational, compliance, security, and technical tradeoffs.
  • Develop implementation-ready architectural guidance that accelerates delivery and reduces ambiguity.
  • Establish architecture patterns that promote reuse, consistency, maintainability, and operational excellence across the ART.
  • Create current-state and future-state architecture views used to drive portfolio planning and modernization activities.

Agile Delivery & Technical Leadership

  • Actively participate in Agile, Scrum, and SAFe planning and delivery activities, providing architectural guidance throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  • Partner with Product Managers, Product Owners, Scrum Masters, Engineering Managers, and Technical Leads to ensure architectural priorities and technical enablers are reflected in team backlogs and delivery plans.
  • Guide decomposition of large initiatives into implementable capabilities, features, and architectural enablers aligned with Agile delivery practices.
  • Mentor engineers and technical leaders, helping elevate architectural maturity and engineering excellence across the ART.
  • Influence technical decision-making and technology adoption across teams without direct managerial authority.
  • Foster a culture of architectural thinking, engineering excellence, continuous learning, and innovation.

Enterprise Architecture Alignment & Governance

  • Serve as the primary architecture representative for the ART, preparing, presenting, and defending solution designs, architecture decisions, technology strategies, and exception requests through Architecture Review Board (ARB) governance processes.
  • Partner with Enterprise Architecture to operationalize enterprise standards, approved reference architectures, architectural guardrails, and strategic platform direction within the ART.
  • Promote and govern adherence to enterprise architecture standards, ensuring solutions align with enterprise technology direction and approved patterns.
  • Drive adoption of approved architectural patterns, shared services, platform capabilities, reusable solutions, and strategic technology platforms across teams and applications within the Value Stream.
  • Partner effectively with Enterprise Architecture, Security, Platform Engineering, Compliance, Infrastructure, Cloud Operations, Developer Experience, AI Enablement, and other shared service organizations.
  • Advocate for Value Stream needs while leveraging enterprise platforms, shared services, and reusable capabilities whenever possible.
  • Track and communicate architectural risks, technical debt, modernization opportunities, major technology decisions, and cross-team dependencies.
  • Maintain visibility into enterprise and platform dependencies that could impact delivery outcomes across the ART.

Architecture Documentation & Knowledge Management

  • Own the architecture repository for the ART and application portfolio.
  • Accountable for maintaining the architectural context, Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), architecture artifacts, and solution documentation for all applications and platforms within the ART.
  • Establish and maintain architectural context including system boundaries, integrations, dependencies, data flows, technology selections, technical constraints, and historical decision records.
  • Create and maintain current-state and future-state architecture documentation for applications and platforms owned within the Value Stream.
  • Maintain architecture diagrams including system context diagrams, integration diagrams, deployment topologies, application interaction diagrams, domain models, sequence diagrams, and solution blueprints.
  • Ensure architecture documentation remains current, accurate, discoverable, and accessible to engineers, architects, leadership, and stakeholders.
  • Establish documentation standards and review processes that institutionalize architecture knowledge and reduce dependency on individual contributors.
  • Maintain architectural knowledge in a manner that enables both engineers and AI-assisted tools to effectively understand and operate within the application portfolio.

Security, Compliance & Operational Excellence

  • Ensure solutions adhere to enterprise security, privacy, audit, regulatory, and compliance requirements.
  • Design architectures that support appropriate handling of Protected Health Information (PHI), Personally Identifiable Information (PII), and other sensitive data assets.
  • Incorporate requirements associated with HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC, SOX, and related compliance frameworks into architectural designs and technology decisions.
  • Partner with Security, Risk, Compliance, and Enterprise Architecture teams to proactively identify and mitigate architectural risks.
  • Ensure security, resiliency, observability, and compliance requirements are incorporated into architectural runway planning and solution design activities.
  • Promote secure-by-design and compliance-by-design practices throughout the software development lifecycle.

Cloud, Platform & Engineering Excellence

  • Design and implement cloud-native architectures utilizing Azure and modern platform services.
  • Promote CoverMyMeds standards for platforms, APIs, integrations, distributed systems, platform services, observability, resiliency, scalability, security, and operational excellence.
  • Collaborate with Security, Platform Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, and Operations teams to align solutions with organizational standards.
  • Evaluate technology investments and modernization initiatives that improve platform reliability, maintainability, scalability, and engineering effectiveness.
  • Guide adoption of engineering platforms and practices leveraging technologies such as Azure, GitHub, Jira, Lucidchart, Microsoft Copilot, Claude, and related engineering productivity tools.

Minimum Qualifications

Degree or equivalent and typically requires 10+ years of relevant experience. Less years required if has relevant Master’s or Doctorate qualifications.

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related discipline.

Critical Skills:

  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, solution architecture, enterprise architecture, or related technology disciplines, including 5+ years in a Lead Architect, Principal Architect, Solution Architect, or equivalent technical-leadership role.
  • Demonstrated experience owning architecture across multiple applications, products, or Agile engineering teams.
  • Experience establishing architectural roadmaps and technical direction within Agile, Scrum, or SAFe delivery environments.
  • Experience designing enterprise solutions using Microsoft Azure or a comparable cloud platform, including cloud-native or distributed architectures, APIs, microservices, event-driven systems, and enterprise integrations.
  • Experience with architecture governance and documentation, including architecture review processes, architecture decision records, technical diagrams, roadmaps, or implementation-ready architecture artifacts.
  • Experience applying DevOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, or related modern engineering practices to enterprise software delivery.
  • Experience designing systems subject to security, privacy, or regulatory requirements, including experience with healthcare or other regulated data environments.
  • Demonstrated experience introducing or supporting AI-assisted software engineering, engineering-productivity initiatives, or agentic engineering practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting an Agile Release Train or Value Stream within a SAFe environment.
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure, GitHub, Jira, Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, Claude, Lucidchart, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience with architecture-as-code, documentation-as-code, policy-as-code, or automated architecture validation.
  • Experience developing enterprise architecture standards, reusable patterns, governance models, or engineering best practices.
  • Experience within healthcare technology or another highly regulated industry.
  • Relevant architecture, cloud, or Agile certifications such as TOGAF, SAFe, Scrum, or Microsoft Azure credentials.

What Success Looks Like

  • Establishes and maintains architectural runway ahead of delivery demand.
  • Ensures teams are never waiting on architecture decisions, technical guidance, standards, patterns, diagrams, ADRs, technical context, or solution designs to execute.
  • Successfully drives adoption of AI-assisted software delivery and agentic engineering practices across the ART in partnership with the CoverMyMeds AI Enablement team.
  • Creates reusable architectural context, documentation standards, repository standards, and knowledge assets that improve both engineering productivity and AI effectiveness.
  • Maintains comprehensive architecture documentation, ADRs, technical roadmaps, architectural context, and current-state/future-state diagrams across the application portfolio.
  • Successfully represents the ART in Architecture Review Board (ARB) reviews and governance processes.
  • Effectively partners with Enterprise Architecture, Security, Platform Engineering, Compliance, AI Enablement, and other CoverMyMeds and McKesson shared service organizations to accelerate delivery while maintaining enterprise alignment.
  • Identifies and addresses architectural risks before they impact delivery.
  • Ensures solutions consistently meet security, compliance, audit, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
  • Advances adoption of modern engineering practices, AI-assisted delivery, and platform modernization initiatives.
  • Serves as a trusted technical advisor to engineering, product, and technology leadership.
  • Raises the overall architectural maturity, technical quality, engineering effectiveness, and delivery outcomes of the Value Stream.

PTC Windchill Developer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: PTC Windchill Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 12+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are seeking an experienced PTC Windchill Developer to design, develop, and support customizations, integrations, and enhancements on the Windchill PLM platform. In this role you will work closely with PLM functional consultants and engineering stakeholders to translate manufacturing and product-lifecycle requirements into well-engineered Windchill solutions. The ideal candidate will combine strong hands-on Windchill Java customization experience with practical knowledge of Windchill data models, workflows, and integration patterns. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop Windchill customizations using the Windchill Java API and PTC-recommended customization patterns.
  • Build custom listeners, services, and processors that extend Windchill behavior without compromising future upgrade paths.
  • Develop and configure Windchill workflows, lifecycle templates, and object initialization rules.
  • Implement custom Info*Engine tasks and adapters for system integration, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.
  • Build custom JSP and HTML client-side extensions where required, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.
  • Design and develop Windchill business reports using report templates and Cognos integration.
  • Configure and operate Windchill Customizer’s tools, RBINFO files, and OIRs.
  • Implement migration scripts for legacy PLM data into Windchill, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.
  • Optimize performance of custom code and database queries, working closely with DBAs.
  • Conduct fit-gap analyses and translate business requirements into clean technical designs.
  • Adhere strictly to PTC customization best practices to ease future upgrades.
  • Provide hypercare and post-go-live support, including issue triage and root-cause analysis.
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.
  • Mentor and coach junior and mid-level engineers through code review, design review, pair programming, and structured knowledge sharing, helping the broader team grow in technical maturity and confidence over time.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 12 or more years of PTC Windchill development experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience with the Windchill Java API.
  • Solid experience with workflows, lifecycle templates, and object initialization rules.
  • Working knowledge of Info*Engine and Windchill integration patterns.
  • Hands-on experience with JSP/HTML client customization.
  • Strong SQL skills and familiarity with the Windchill data model.
  • Experience with Windchill upgrades and migrations.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and documentation skills.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • PTC Windchill certifications.
  • Experience with Creo, Arbortext, or related PTC products.
  • Exposure to Windchill RV&S (Integrity) or ThingWorx integration.
  • Familiarity with CAD data management workflows.
  • Experience operating Windchill on cloud platforms.

We're a remote-first team of 150+ people across 25+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance.

This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading.

The Role

We’re looking for a Product oriented Fullstack Engineer to design, build, ship, and own end-to-end product features used by thousands of developers and hundreds of millions of end-users.

We’re specifically looking for someone with a strong backend foundation who is also genuinely proficient in React.

This is a hands-on IC role. We are looking for someone product-focused, but deeply technical. You’ll work across frontend, backend, and data boundaries, making thoughtful tradeoffs to deliver reliable, high-quality systems. You’ll take ownership from problem definition through production rollout and long-term maintenance, the scoping and prioritization work as much as the code.

“Product-focused” at RevenueCat means pairing strong engineering fundamentals with good judgment, customer obsession, and a bias toward shipping — not trading correctness, reliability, or scalability for speed, but also not letting “perfect” get in the way of “shipped today.”

About You

  • You have 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong backend foundation and a track record of building and operating high-scale production systems.

  • You can write advanced SQL statements beyond basic SELECT and UPDATE statements.

  • You’re proficient in React and have genuinely built on the frontend before. You’re comfortable owning UI work, not just backend APIs.

  • You have solid HTML, CSS, and JavaScript fundamentals, and an understanding of HTTP and browser–server interactions

  • You hold a high bar for quality and instinctively know which details matter, but also are discerning enough to cut scope when needed while still delivering value.

  • You’re customer-obsessed: you imagine yourself as the developer, product manager, or marketer using the feature or experiencing the issue.

  • You’re a builder, not an implementer: scoping, prioritizing, and driving rollout in partnership with our Product team. This isn’t a role where you check off items from a detailed specification.

  • You can quickly familiarize yourself with code you didn't write yourself and improve it.

  • You're comfortable coding alongside AI tools like Copilot, Cursor, or Claude Code. You use them to move faster on the parts that don't need your full attention, and you're detail-oriented enough to catch when they're wrong.

  • You’re scrappy and biased toward shipping. You’d rather ship a good version today and iterate than wait to ship a perfect one next quarter.

  • You communicate clearly, both in real-time and asynchronously. We’re a fully remote team, and how you write is as important as how you code.

  • You’ve shipped meaningful user-facing features to production, monitored their usage and adoption, and improved them over time.

  • You write high-quality, well-tested code, debug issues methodically, and help raise the engineering bar through thoughtful feedback and mentorship.

  • You act like an founder:: you notice problems, propose improvements, and follow through fast.

Technologies you’ll likely work with:

  • TypeScript

  • React

  • PostgreSQL

  • Python

  • Flask

  • AWS-hosted systems, following best practices for deployment, monitoring, and reliability

A note: Our interview process includes two separate live-coding sessions: one on frontend fundamentals and one on SQL, data logic, and algorithmic programming. We've found strength in both is a strong predictor of success in this role.

In the first month, you’ll:

  • Meet frequently with your team and manager to get up to speed.

  • Get familiar with our tools, processes, and core subscription-business concepts.

  • Complete a First Ship project.

  • Jump in early: fix bugs, ship small improvements, and weigh in on PRs.

Within the first 3 months, you’ll:

  • Have shipped a medium-sized project successfully.

  • Understand the main product areas your team owns and how they work end to end.

  • Scope and work on projects self-sufficiently, from idea to post-launch improvements.

  • Actively participate in code reviews, bug bashes, and technical discussions.

  • Continuously improve areas of your team’s codebase and product.

Within the first 6 months, you’ll:

  • Become the go-to engineer for certain focus areas.

  • Proactively contribute to architecture discussions that impact more than just your team.

  • Debug issues across frontend, backend, and data; communicate clearly during incidents; drive fixes that prevent repeats.

  • Engage directly with customers to understand how your work actually lands.

  • Mentor other engineers joining the team and raise the bar through feedback and guidance.

Within the first 12 months, you’ll:

  • Know all the major components of our system and be able to debug complex issues across it.

  • Spec and architect large projects, gather feedback, and drive design validation and rollout plans.

  • Lead your own initiatives for improving our product and systems, grounded in real customer and business priorities.

What we offer:

Our ML team is small and highly collaborative, working on challenging problems that impact hundreds of millions of Quora users. We encourage engineers to think big, experiment with new ideas, and continuously learn and improve. With over 100 ML models in production, engineers have opportunities to take ownership of meaningful projects, work closely with experienced teammates, and quickly see the impact of their work.

We're building the next generation of AI-powered systems to improve content quality and safety across Quora. By leveraging LLMs and agentic workflows, we're transforming how we detect harmful content, automate complex decisions, and respond to evolving challenges at scale. As a Machine Learning Engineer (New Grad), you'll work alongside experienced engineers to design, evaluate, and deploy these systems in production.

No previous trust and safety experience is required. You'll learn from the engineers who built these systems.

Stack: Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Spark, Kubernetes

Responsibilities:

  • Design and improve ML systems that adapt to evolving abuse patterns and new challenges

  • Evaluate agent performance through offline evaluations, online experiments, and production monitoring, balancing accuracy, reliability, latency, and cost

  • Investigate failure cases, experiment with new approaches, and iterate on solutions to improve system performance

  • Strong understanding of mathematical foundations of Machine Learning algorithms

  • Coursework, research, or project experience with LLM applications or transformer models

  • Strong knowledge of Python

  • A passion for learning and always improving yourself and the team around you

Eligibility & Clearance Requirements

Due to federal contract requirements supporting USCIS programs, applicants must:

  • Be a U.S. Citizen.
  • Currently reside within the United States.
  • Have lived within the U.S. for at least 3 of the past 5 years.
  • Be eligible to obtain and maintain a government Public Trust clearance.

Your Route Into ServiceNow Development

At Via Logic, we believe great technology should make complex work simpler, faster, and more reliable. We’re looking for a Mid-Level ServiceNow Developer who enjoys building scalable solutions, solving technical challenges, and collaborating with both technical and non-technical teams.

In this role, you’ll support the design, development, and implementation of solutions across the ServiceNow platform, including custom and scoped applications, integrations, workflow automation, Service Catalog capabilities, and locally developed applications.

You’ll work closely with ServiceNow architects, developers, citizen developers, analysts, and client stakeholders to translate business requirements into secure, maintainable technical solutions. You’ll also support CI/CD movements between environments, participate in code reviews and demonstrations, troubleshoot complex issues, and help ensure development follows ServiceNow and enterprise best practices.

This role provides the opportunity to contribute directly to mission-critical systems supporting the Department of Homeland Security while continuing to deepen your ServiceNow expertise across application development, integrations, automation, and platform delivery.

Your Mission Today

Your Responsibilities:

  • ServiceNow Development: Design, develop, configure, and deploy custom applications and solutions within the ServiceNow platform.
  • Scoped Applications & Workflow Automation: Create and configure scoped applications, Service Catalog items, Flow Designer workflows, and other platform-based solutions that support client needs.
  • Custom Application Development: Support the design and development of locally developed applications (LDAs) using ServiceNow development best practices.
  • Integrations: Lead and support integrations between ServiceNow and external systems, ensuring reliable data exchange and platform functionality.
  • CI/CD & Deployment: Support the movement of ServiceNow components, collections, and deployable assets through CI/CD pipelines and across development environments.
  • Technical Collaboration: Work closely with ServiceNow architects, developers, analysts, and stakeholders to map business requirements and services to appropriate ServiceNow capabilities.
  • Code Reviews & Demonstrations: Participate in code reviews, proofs of concept, technical discussions, and product demonstrations.
  • Troubleshooting & Configuration: Perform troubleshooting, coding, scripting, and ServiceNow configuration activities of moderate to high complexity.
  • Citizen Developer Support: Provide guidance and mentorship to citizen developers and other team members working within the ServiceNow ecosystem.
  • Platform Administration: Support the administration, deployment, and management of USCIS systems and PaaS, SaaS, and IaaS platforms as required using authorized privileged access.

What Helps Explorers Succeed Here

Your Required Skills and Experience:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Experience: Minimum of 3 years of experience developing solutions on the ServiceNow platform.
  • Certification: At least one current ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certification.
  • ServiceNow Development: Hands-on experience designing, developing, configuring, and deploying ServiceNow applications and platform solutions.
  • Integrations: Experience developing and supporting ServiceNow integrations with external systems.
  • ITSM & Scoped Applications: Experience working with ServiceNow ITSM capabilities and scoped application development.
  • CI/CD: Experience supporting CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes within a ServiceNow environment.
  • Technical Development: Strong scripting and development capabilities, including JavaScript and related ServiceNow development technologies.
  • Communication: Strong client-facing communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Teamwork: Ability to work collaboratively within Agile, cross-functional development teams.

Types of Badges and Certifications:

  • Experience working with the ServiceNow Configuration Management Database (CMDB).
  • Experience developing custom ServiceNow applications.
  • Familiarity with federal government or DHS environments.
  • Experience working in Agile and DevSecOps delivery environments.
  • Current Public Trust clearance or previous experience successfully completing a federal background investigation.

Why Explorers Stay

  • Remote-first flexibility within the U.S.
  • Comprehensive healthcare benefits.
  • Generous Paid Time Off (PTO).
  • Collaborative and supportive team culture focused on growth and continuous learning.
  • Opportunities to expand into broader engineering and DevSecOps ownership areas.
  • Meaningful work supporting mission-driven programs with real-world impact.

How We Work

  • This is a client-facing role that includes virtual collaboration and occasional customer interaction.
  • Team members are expected to actively engage through Slack, Teams, email, Monday.com, and other collaboration tools during standard business hours.
  • Availability for meetings and collaboration between 9AM–5PM EST is expected.
  • Cameras on during virtual meetings is part of our collaborative culture.

About Via Logic

Via Logic LLC is an information technology partner supporting mission-driven work across DevSecOps, cloud engineering, cybersecurity, data science, and national security analytics for federal and commercial clients. Our teams help modernize complex systems through automation, secure engineering practices, cloud-native technologies, and scalable infrastructure solutions that support real-world impact. But beyond the work itself, we care deeply about how we work. We believe great teams are built through collaboration, curiosity, accountability, and trust. Whether you're supporting customer missions, strengthening business operations, or leading expeditions of your own, Via Logic is a place where Explorers are encouraged to grow, contribute, and continuously evolve.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Via Logic LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where all Explorers are valued and supported. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, or local law. We believe different perspectives strengthen teams, improve innovation, and help us build better solutions for the missions we support.

Accessibility & Accommodations

Via Logic is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring experience for all candidates. Reasonable accommodations are available throughout the application and interview process to support accessibility needs and ensure every candidate has an equitable opportunity to explore a career with our team.

Recruiting Fraud Notice

Via Logic takes recruiting fraud seriously. We will never ask candidates for payment, banking information, cryptocurrency, gift cards, or other personal financial information during any stage of the hiring process. All legitimate communication from our team will come directly from authorized Via Logic representatives using official company channels. Due to the rise of fraudulent recruiting activity across the industry, we encourage candidates to use caution if something feels unusual, rushed, or too good to be true. About Supabase

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the Role

We’re building a high-performance CI/CD execution platform similar to runners used by tools like Buildkite, GitHub Actions, and Blacksmith CI. Our platform executes developer pipelines reliably at scale, integrates deeply with source control, and automates build, test, and deployment workflows.

In this role, you will design and build the distributed systems responsible for running CI/CD pipelines securely and efficiently. This includes orchestrating ephemeral compute environments, managing build isolation, scheduling jobs across fleets of workers, and ensuring reliability at scale.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

  • Design and improve the core orchestration engine that manages the lifecycle of creating, merging, and rebasing Supabase Branches.

  • Provision ephemeral sandboxed execution environment on EKS / ECS for running untrusted build workloads from connected git repositories with securely managed secrets.

  • Implement job scheduling that scale to thousands of concurrent builds.

  • Optimize and reduce pipeline runtimes with caching, artifact storage, and dependency reuse.

  • Manage retry, timeout, cancellation, and failure-propagation logic to ensure pipelines behave predictably under failure conditions.

  • Instrument the full pipeline lifecycle with observability tooling to surface traces, metrics, and structured logs to the end user.

  • Develop configuration files (JSON / TOML) and integrations (Terraform / Pulumi) that allow teams to easily define, trigger, and inspect pipelines in code.

You Might Be a Good Fit If You

  • Have strong software engineering skills (Go and Typescript required);

  • Have 3+ years of experience building and operating cloud infrastructure or distributed systems at scale;

  • Have cloud Infrastructure knowledge - familiarity with AWS constructs is required, past experience using the AWS SDKs and IaC tools (Pulumi, Terraform, etc) to build and operate infrastructure is strongly preferred.

  • Have a production operations mindset - track record of building reliable, observable, and maintainable systems

  • Have an ownership mindset - you thrive in being able to operate independently with high-level guidance

  • Communicate clearly across both technical and non-technical audiences

  • Have experience in async or globally distributed teams

  • Are energized by solving real-world problems for developers

  • Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and moving quickly

What We Offer

  • Fully Remote

    We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

  • ESOP

    Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

  • Tech Allowance

    Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

  • Health Benefits

    Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

  • Annual Off-Sites

    Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

  • Flexible Work

    We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

  • Professional Development

    Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

  • ~400 team members

  • 60+ countries

  • 20+ languages spoken

  • Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

  • 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

data.description:
AECOM is seeking a Natural Gas Compression Subject Matter Expert (SME) to join our multi-disciplinary design team in support of a major gas transmission projects. This role is a remote position and the selected candidate as the opportunity to work a remote schedule.

In this role, the selected individual will serve as the firm’s lead technical authority for compression stations, establishing overall compression philosophy, equipment selection criteria (reciprocating vs. centrifugal compressors), driver selection (gas turbines, electric motors), and station layout standardization.

This position serves as the primary technical authority for gas compression process and equipment selection, providing top-level engineering direction, technical governance, and oversight across all compression station designs.

For this role, AECOM offers the freedom and flexibility to work remotely and/or be located at a variety of Industrial and Power Generation offices across the United States. Primary locations are Houston, TX, Austin, TX, Denver, CO, and New Orleans, LA.

The job responsibilities of the position will include but are not limited to

  • Define over-pressure protection systems, relief valves, and blowdown system strategies in strict accordance with API, ASME, and CFR.
  • Lead and review complex thermodynamic and gas hydraulic calculations, including multi-stage compressor sizing, intercooling/aftercooling design, fuel gas system conditioning, and transient gas flow behavior.
  • Direct and review specialized dynamic analysis, including pulsation/acoustic studies (API 618/API 688), torsional vibration analysis, and pipe stress/surge analysis (ASME B31.8 / AFT Impulse) to ensure system integrity across operating envelopes.
  • Author and review critical technical specifications and data sheet packages for major rotating equipment (compressor packages, gas turbines, engines, coolers, scrubbers, gas filtration).
  • Lead high-level Technical Bid Evaluations (TBEs), vendor package integration, factory acceptance testing (FAT) witness points, and technical alignment across major OEM suppliers.
  • Drive standardization to streamline engineering, procurement, and constructability while adapting to site-specific pressure ratios, flow regimes, and gas compositions.
  • Review critical project deliverables, including Process Flow Diagrams (PFDs), Piping & Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs), compressor building layouts, ESD (Emergency Shut-Down) system logic, and hazard mitigation plans.
  • Support proposal development with technical write-ups, compression strategy narratives, engineering hour estimations, and client presentation support.
  • Interface directly with client leadership, regulatory bodies, and operations teams as AECOM's key technical representative for gas compression strategy.
  • Conduct high-level technical reviews and check engineering calculations produced by design teams.
  • Mentor senior and mid-level mechanical engineers on pipeline dynamics, rotating equipment specifications, and industry best practices.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

  • BA/BS in Mechanical Engineering or related field + 8 years of related experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
  • 8 years of experience in mechanical design engineering within the natural gas, pipeline midstream, or energy infrastructure sectors.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) License.
  • Proven track record as a Lead Engineer or SME on large-scale natural gas compression station projects (greenfield or major brownfield expansions).
  • Understanding of design, industrial process and energy projects.
  • Experience in industrial and/or energy-related fields.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Masters Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field.
  • Extensive experience with major compressor technologies (large reciprocating compressor packages and/or gas-turbine-driven centrifugal units) and associated auxiliary systems (lube oil, seal gas, fuel gas, glycol/cooling water, wash systems).
  • Expert-level knowledge of ASME B31.8 (Gas Transmission and Distribution Piping Systems), 49 CFR Part 192, API 618 (Reciprocating Compressors), API 617 (Centrifugal Compressors), API 619, API 692 (Dry Gas Seals), API 520/521, and ASME Section VIII Div 1/2.
  • Hands-on expertise or oversight capabilities with gas hydraulic and compressor performance tools (e.g., AFT Arrow, AFT Impulse, Synergy, HYSYS/UniSim, Pipe-Flo, CAESAR II, or proprietary OEM compressor sizing tools like Ariel Performance / Solar Compressors).
  • Strong working understanding of environmental, air quality, and acoustic compliance constraints related to compressor station noise and emissions control (NOx, methane slip, turbine exhaust).
  • Sponsorship for US employment authorization is not available now or in the future for this position.
  • Relocation is not available for this position.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. We are creating a future where traditional sampling methods are obsolete. Our mission is to be the leading soil information company, delivering maps that growers, farmers, ranchers, and other stakeholders use to cost-effectively increase yields, improve soil health and the climate and feed the growing world through all things soil.

We are a growing company with a passion for soil health, innovative technologies, and supporting all within the food value chain. We currently have ~100 individuals spread across 20 states and 2 countries, and they come from all walks of life, industries, and experiences. We are deeply focused on building the future of AgTech and sustainability and helping the world see soil differently.

Our Senior Software Engineer will join our Software Engineering team to impact our mission through individual contributor responsibilities to design, build and maintain the technology that powers EarthOptics’ products and operations. This is a hands-on technical leadership role requiring strong full-stack engineering capabilities, experience with modern cloud infrastructure, and the ability to independently own complex software systems. You'll work across frontend applications, backend services, APIs, and cloud infrastructure while helping shape technical decisions and improve engineering practices.

The digs:

  • Job Type: Full-time, salaried, exempt (not eligible for overtime)
  • Work Location: This remote position is open to candidates authorized to work in the United States who reside in the contiguous 48 states, with a preference for those who can consistently align their working hours with US Central Time.
  • Travel: 5% of the time
  • Target Start Date: December 2026
  • Application Deadline: Applications will be accepted through November 30, 2026.

    $125,000 to $165,000 annual base salary, plus eligibility for our bonus program and an equity option grant (see below).
    • *This range covers all US locations where this remote role can be performed. Your offer will reflect the pay zone for your location and your job-related skills and experience, assessed consistently for every candidate. We do not ask about current or past pay.

What you’ll cultivate as a Senior Software Engineer: (Your responsibilities)

  • Own the end-to-end design, development, deployment, and maintenance of full-stack applications, spanning user interfaces, backend services, APIs, and data integrations.

  • Technical Debt & Reliability: Identify and begin addressing high-priority technical debt, performance bottlenecks, or reliability issues, with actionable recommendations for improving system maintainability.
  • AI-Assisted Engineering: Evaluate AI development tools, demonstrate practical applications, and recommend approaches that improve engineering productivity without compromising quality.

Are you our soil-mate? You’ll bloom in this role if you have experience in: (Your qualifications)
