  • Proven ability to drive the development and execution of complex rack solutions for hyperscale or large-scale data center environments, managing 12-18 month lifecycles and portfolios valued at hundreds of millions of dollars.

  • Familiarity with industry standards (EIA, ORV3, OCP) and global power architectures.

  • Demonstrated experience working directly with customers in technical and commercially sensitive environments.

  • Strong background in program execution, including schedule ownership, risk management, and cross-functional leadership.

  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills – a must.

  • Strong understanding of mechanical systems, integration strategies, and program management.

  • Hands-on experience with prototype fabrication and testing (mechanical S&V, software burn-in and test validation).

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

  • Capable of assessing projects, articulating risks, and developing project milestones.

  • Creative, self-motivated, accountable, and team-oriented.

  • Able to work independently with minimal oversight.

  • Skilled in writing reports, business correspondence, and procedural guides.

  • Effective at presenting information and responding to management, clients, and public queries.

  • Capable of influencing others and sharing best practices.

  • Familiar with stage-gate processes in project lifecycle management (PLM).

  • Able to coach and mentor less experienced engineers.

  • Demonstrated success leading in a highly matrixed environment, driving alignment and execution across cross-functional teams without direct reporting authority.

  • Ability to travel both domestically and internationally up to 30%.

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Master’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related field is preferred.

  • Proficiency in CAD tools (e.g., SolidWorks, Creo/Pro-E, Inventor) and FEA software (e.g., ANSYS, Abaqus).

data.title: Senior Technical Trainer — AI / DevOps Remote, worldwide
data.description:
Senior Technical Trainer — AI / DevOps

Remote, worldwide · Freelance course project with a path to full-time

We’re hiring on behalf of a global hands-on tech-education platform used by over a million engineers to learn DevOps, cloud, Kubernetes and AI. Its courses are built around real labs, not slides, and taught by practising engineers who are great on camera.

We’re looking for a DevOps engineer who loves teaching to create and present a course on AI for DevOps: how engineers use AI agents and modern AI tooling in real infrastructure work.

This role suits you if you already teach as part of what you do: you’ve published courses on Udemy, Pluralsight or YouTube, written a book, worked in DevRel, run workshops, or regularly speak at meetups and conferences.

How it works

  • It starts with one paid course project. You can do it alongside your current job. There’s no fixed weekly-hour requirement, just a delivery plan you agree on together. A typical project takes around 3 months.

  • The goal is long-term. The team is growing its internal trainer pool, and the first project is how both sides find out if it’s a fit. After that, it can lead to a full-time role or more course projects.

  • A fixed fee per course is agreed upfront, based on course length and topic complexity. Fees are competitive, and advanced topics and exceptional instructors are paid accordingly. Payment is made on delivery of the completed course.

  • Fully remote with flexible hours. Expect a weekly sync, Slack communication, and some time-zone overlap with a Europe/Asia-based team.

What you’ll do

  • Shape the course with the curriculum team: sections, lessons, and hands-on labs.

  • Write lab specs that a dedicated labs team builds, then test them.

  • Write and narrate short, story-driven video lessons (about 6 minutes each). You’re welcome to use AI to draft, but the final script should sound like you.

  • Record demo and lab-solution walkthroughs.

  • Work through structured editorial feedback, especially on your first section.

Video editing, animation, lab infrastructure and publishing are all handled by the production team. You focus on the teaching.

What we’re looking for

  • Hands-on DevOps foundations: Linux, containers, Kubernetes, a major cloud, CI/CD, IaC. You build and run infrastructure yourself.

  • Real, current use of AI in your engineering work: AI agents, coding assistants, LLM-based automation. Deep AI specialisation isn’t required, but curiosity and staying current are.

  • Excellent spoken and written English. All courses are scripted, narrated and delivered in English, so you need clear, natural, easily understood English and confidence on camera.

  • A genuine passion for teaching, shown through courses, tutorials, talks, workshops or mentoring you’ve done because you enjoy it.

  • The ability to explain complex topics simply, with empathy for beginners.

  • Clear, engaging spoken English and confidence on camera.

  • Openness to an established teaching methodology and to editorial feedback.

Nice to have

  • Published online courses or a book.

  • Conference talks, a growing YouTube channel or blog, or community roles (CNCF Ambassador, AWS Community Builder, Microsoft MVP, etc.).

  • Kubernetes (CKA/CKAD/CKS, Kubestronaut) or AWS/Azure certifications.

How to apply
Send your CV or LinkedIn profile, plus a link that shows how you teach: a course, a talk, a tutorial or a short video.

data.description:
Description

Keeper Security is hiring an IT Support Engineer, Tier 2 to join our IT team and provide advanced technical support for employees, office infrastructure and on-site systems at our El Dorado Hills, CA location. This role requires candidates to be local to the El Dorado Hills area and work on-site a minimum of 3 days per week, with additional on-site coverage as needed for projects, incidents or infrastructure support.

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and help maintain the reliable, secure technology environment that supports Keeper’s employees and business operations.

About Keeper

Keeper Security is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero-knowledge and zero-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just-in-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com.

About the Job

The IT Support Engineer, Tier 2 will report to the Director of IT and provide advanced end-user support while serving as a key on-site technical resource for Keeper’s El Dorado Hills office.

This role will handle escalated support issues across hardware, software, identity, networking and endpoint systems while also supporting physical IT infrastructure including server racks, network equipment and on-site servers. You will work closely with Tier 1 support, senior IT resources and third-party vendors to resolve issues, maintain office technology and support IT projects. The ideal candidate is comfortable troubleshooting beyond standard desktop support and can move between end-user issues and hands-on infrastructure work in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

  • Provide Tier 2 technical support for escalated hardware, software, endpoint, identity and access issues
  • Serve as a primary on-site IT resource for Keeper’s El Dorado Hills office
  • Install, configure, troubleshoot and maintain Windows and macOS workstations, laptops, mobile devices and related peripherals
  • Support physical IT infrastructure including server racks, on-site servers, network switches, cabling, UPS systems and related equipment
  • Assist with rack-and-stack activities, hardware replacement, server maintenance and basic infrastructure troubleshooting
  • Support office network connectivity including wired and wireless access, DNS, DHCP, VPN and basic network troubleshooting
  • Troubleshoot user access, authentication, MFA, account provisioning and identity-related issues
  • Support employee onboarding and offboarding, including device provisioning, access changes and asset coordination
  • Escalate complex infrastructure, security or systems issues to Tier 3 resources while providing clear troubleshooting documentation
  • Monitor, triage and resolve IT service requests and incidents in accordance with internal service expectations
  • Maintain accurate IT asset records and conduct regular inventory audits
  • Assist with endpoint management, software deployment and device configuration through MDM and related management platforms
  • Support office-based technology including conference room systems, printers, access control and other workplace systems
  • Partner with third-party vendors and service providers on infrastructure, network and hardware-related projects
  • Maintain technical documentation, troubleshooting procedures and knowledge base articles
  • Mentor Tier 1 support team members and assist with escalation handling and technical guidance
  • Participate in IT projects involving endpoint deployment, network upgrades, office infrastructure and system improvements
  • Use AI-assisted tools such as Gemini, ChatGPT or similar platforms to improve troubleshooting, documentation and workflow efficiency
  • Provide occasional after-hours support for critical office or infrastructure issues as needed

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in IT support, desktop support, systems support or a related technical role
  • Experience providing Tier 2 or escalated technical support in a business environment
  • Strong hands-on experience supporting Microsoft Windows and macOS environments
  • Experience working with physical servers, server racks, switches, cabling or other on-site IT infrastructure
  • Working knowledge of networking concepts including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, VLANs and wireless networking
  • Experience troubleshooting hardware, operating systems, software, user access and connectivity issues
  • Familiarity with enterprise identity and access concepts including MFA, user provisioning, groups and permissions
  • Experience provisioning and supporting laptops, desktops, mobile devices and common productivity applications
  • Familiarity with cloud-based platforms such as Google Workspace, Microsoft Azure or similar technologies
  • Familiarity with endpoint management or MDM platforms
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with a customer-service mindset
  • Ability to work independently on-site and determine when issues require escalation
  • Ability and willingness to use AI-assisted tools effectively to improve troubleshooting, documentation and day-to-day IT operations
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds and safely move, install or replace IT hardware as part of regular job duties
  • Must reside within reasonable commuting distance of Keeper’s El Dorado Hills, CA office and be able to work on-site a minimum of 3 days per week

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting Windows Server or Linux server environments
  • Experience with rack-and-stack, server hardware maintenance or data center / server room support
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Intune, Kandji or similar endpoint management platforms
  • Experience supporting Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta or similar identity platforms
  • Experience with switches, firewalls, wireless access points or other network infrastructure
  • Familiarity with virtualization technologies such as VMware or Hyper-V
  • Experience supporting office AV, conference room or physical access systems
  • Relevant CompTIA, Microsoft, networking or IT support certifications
  • Experience working in a security-conscious or compliance-driven environment

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental & Vision (inclusive of domestic partnerships)
  • Employer Paid Life Insurance & Employee/Spouse/Child Supplemental life
  • Voluntary Short/Long Term Disability Insurance
  • 401K (Roth/Traditional)
  • A generous PTO plan that celebrates your commitment and seniority (including paid Bereavement/Jury Duty, etc)
  • Above market annual bonuses

Keeper Security, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and participant in the U.S. Federal E-Verify program. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Classification: Exempt

Keeper Candidate Privacy Notice

This notice explains how Keeper Security processes your personal data during recruitment. Depending on the role and location, the Controller of personal data (the organization responsible for determining why and how personal data is processed) will be Keeper Security Inc. (US), Keeper Security EMEA Ltd. (Ireland), or Keeper Security APAC K.K (Japan).

1. Data We Collect

Information You provide:

  • Contact details, CV/resume, cover letter
  • Employment history, qualifications, work eligibility
  • Application responses and uploaded documents

Information We generate:

  • Interview notes, assessments, communications
  • Scheduling information

Information From Others:

  • Recruiter/referral information who submit your profile
  • References (with your consent, before final offer)
  • Public professional profiles
  • Background verification (post offer)

Voluntary Diversity and Equal Opportunity Information

  • We may ask you to voluntarily provide diversity information including race/ethnicity, gender, disability status and veteran status (US). Providing this information is optional and Keeper collects this data in order to comply with EEOC and similar requirements

2. How We Use Your Data

  • Assess your application and suitability
  • Manage interviews and recruitment workflow
  • Consider you for other/future roles (we may seek your consent to keep your information on our systems beyond the retention period specified)
  • Comply with employment law obligations

3. Legal Basis

  • Legitimate Interests (recruitment management, security and integrity of the hiring process)
  • Contracting steps (for progressed candidates)
  • Legal and regulatory compliance obligations; explicit consent where required

4. Who We Share Information With

Internal:

  • HR, hiring managers, interviewers*, IT support for system administration

*Note - diversity and equal opportunity data is not shared with hiring managers.

Third Parties:

Service providers who assist with:

  • Applicant tracking, recruitment systems and assessment providers
  • Background verification vendors (post offer)
  • Recruitment agencies (where applicable)
  • Tools to support communication, collaboration and to securely store your data

Keeper ensures that all our third parties are contractually bound to protect your personal data with adequate safeguards in place.

5. International Transfers

Your data may be accessed by Keeper entities globally as needed for the purposes of hiring and decision making. We protect any such data transfer between Keeper entities using appropriate safeguards under applicable data protection laws.

6. Security

We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data, consistent with our industry leading security standards.

7. Retention

We keep your data for 24 months from your last application activity, then delete or anonymize it.

Exceptions:

  • You opt into our talent database for further retention by providing consent (extended retention)
  • You're hired (transfers to employee records)

8. Your Rights

You have the following rights and can contact us at the email below to exercise them:

  • Access, correct, or delete your data, subject to applicable law and retention requirements
  • Object to or restrict processing
  • Withdraw consent (where applicable)
  • Request data portability
  • Lodge a complaint with your data protection authority

If you become an employee, your rights regarding your employee record are governed by our internal Employee Privacy Notice and certain data will be retained as required under relevant laws such as employment or tax law. 

When you request access to your personal data, some information may be redacted if it includes the personal data of other individuals or information that we must protect in order to preserve their privacy rights.

9. Automated Decisions

Keeper does not make hiring decisions using solely automated processing.

10. Contact - Candidates can send privacy questions to: privacy@keepersecurity.com

data.description:
NVIDIA is looking for Senior Cloud Infrastructure and DevOps Solutions Architect to join its ANZ Team, specifically focused on working with our Neo Clouds and their customers on stand up and operational excellence. Ideally the successful candidate would be located in either Sydney or Melbourne. Enterprise, Government and Academic Research groups around the world are using NVIDIA products to redefine deep learning and data analytics, and to power data workloads. Be involved with the crew developing many of the largest and fastest AI/HPC systems in the world! We are looking for someone with the ability to work on a dynamic customer focused team that requires excellent interpersonal skills. This role will be interacting with Neo Clouds, customers, partners and various departments, to analyze, define and implement and operate large scale AI Operational projects. The scope of these efforts includes a combination of System Building, Kubernetes-based platforms, Automation, Hardware and Networking.

What you'll be doing:

  • Maintain large scale computational and AI infrastructure, focusing on monitoring, logging, workload orchestration (Kubernetes and Linux job schedulers).

  • Optimize scalable, production-ready Kubernetes-based container platforms coordinated with enterprise-grade networking and storage.

  • Serve as a key technical resource, develop, refine, and document standard methodologies and operational guidelines to be shared with internal teams.

  • Perform end-to-end resolving across the stack, from bare metal and operating system, through the software stack, container platform, networking, and storage.

  • Support Enterprise, Research & Development activities and engage in POCs/POVs to validate new features, architectures, and upgrade approaches.

  • Deploy monitoring solutions for the servers, network and storage with a focus on services performance and availability optimisations to meet requirements and SLAs.

  • Develop tooling to automate deployment and management of large-scale infrastructure environments, to automate operational monitoring and alerting, and to enable self-service consumption of resources.

  • Create and deliver high-quality documentation, including runbooks, onboarding materials, and best-practice guides for customers and internal teams.

  • Become the technical leader for assigned customer accounts, providing strategic guidance on DevOps and platform architecture and influencing long-term infrastructure and operations decisions.

What we need to see:

  • BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or related fields, with 5+ years of professional experience in managing scalable cloud environments and automation engineering roles.

  • Kubernetes & AI/ML Workloads: Extensive experience with Kubernetes for container orchestration, resource scheduling, scaling, and integration with HPC environments.

  • Cloud & HPC Expertise: Proven understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP stack), data center architectures, and hands-on experience managing HPC/AI clusters, including deployment, optimization, and fixing issues.

  • Hardware & Software Knowledge: Familiarity with HPC and AI technologies (CPUs, GPUs, high-speed interconnects) and supporting software stacks.

  • Linux & Storage Systems: Deep knowledge of Linux (RedHat/CentOS, Ubuntu), OS-level security, and protocols (TCP, DHCP, DNS). Experience with storage solutions such as Lustre, GPFS, ZFS, XFS, and emerging Kubernetes storage technologies.

  • Automation & Observability: Proficiency in Python and Bash scripting, configuration management, and Infrastructure-as-Code tools (e.g., Ansible, Terraform). Experience with observability stacks (Grafana, Loki, Prometheus) for monitoring, logging, and building fault-tolerant systems.

  • Solution Architecture & Customer Engagement: Strong background in crafting scalable solutions and providing consultative support to customers.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines for software deployment and automation.

  • Solid hands-on knowledge of Kubernetes and container-based microservices architectures.

  • Experience with GPU-focused hardware and software (e.g., NVIDIA DGX, CUDA, GPU Operator).

  • Background with RDMA-based fabrics (InfiniBand or RoCE) in HPC or AI environments.

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

data.title: Senior AI & Full-Stack Engineer - DevOps & Technical Leadership
data.description:
Location: 100% Remote

Employment: Full-time, long-term position

Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement

Salary: Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with the potential for substantial growth during the first few years

About UsWe are a startup developing software products, web applications, AI-powered tools, integrations, and business automations across different projects.

Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We work with external developers and specialists, and we need strong technical leadership to turn their contributions into reliable, maintainable software.

AI-assisted and agentic development are central to how we work. We want to move quickly, make sensible technical decisions, and build solutions that our team can understand, operate, and improve.

We are looking for an experienced engineer who wants to join at an early stage, take meaningful responsibility, and grow with the company.

Job DescriptionWe are seeking a Senior AI & Full-Stack Engineer who can develop applications across frontend and backend, integrate AI capabilities, and manage the Linux infrastructure, databases, and deployment processes supporting them.

You should be comfortable taking a project from an initial business requirement through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation. You will work across different products and internal initiatives, helping us choose practical solutions and deliver them efficiently.

Alongside hands-on engineering, your responsibilities may include leading developers, mentoring less experienced colleagues, coordinating outsourced contributors, and reviewing externally delivered work. Previous team leadership and mentoring experience are therefore important.

This is an opportunity to help establish the engineering foundations of a growing startup and develop into a broader technical leadership position.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain web applications across frontend and backend.
  • Build AI-powered features, integrations, internal tools, and business automations.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents effectively, with appropriate testing and human review.
  • Translate business requirements into clear implementation tasks and verifiable acceptance criteria.
  • Design APIs, business logic, authentication, authorization, and third-party integrations.
  • Manage database schemas, migrations, query performance, backups, and recovery procedures.
  • Administer Linux servers, including application services, permissions, updates, networking, and troubleshooting.
  • Build and maintain Docker environments, including container networking, persistent storage, configuration, and health checks.
  • Manage DNS records, domain routing, TLS certificates, and reverse proxies.
  • Maintain CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines, and appropriate build agents or runners.
  • Carry out deployments with migration checks, rollback procedures, and post-deployment verification.
  • Investigate production incidents and address their underlying causes.
  • Coordinate outsourced developers and specialists, clarify requirements, review deliverables, and manage technical dependencies.
  • Mentor developers through code reviews, practical demonstrations, and constructive feedback.
  • Keep implementation proportionate to the problem, controlling unnecessary complexity, infrastructure costs, and maintenance overhead.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production web applications.
  • Strong frontend development skills using a modern framework, JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Strong backend development experience, including secure APIs, integrations, validation, and error handling.
  • Practical experience integrating AI or LLM capabilities into software, including checking output quality, handling failures, and managing latency and usage costs.
  • Substantial hands-on experience with AI coding assistants or agentic development workflows, with examples of working results you independently verified.
  • Strong SQL and relational database experience, including migrations, indexing, performance analysis, and backup and recovery.
  • Hands-on Linux administration and Docker deployment experience.
  • A working understanding of DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, firewalls, ports, and reverse proxies.
  • Practical CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions and familiarity with Azure DevOps repositories, pipelines, and build agents.
  • Strong Git, pull-request, code-review, and release-management skills.
  • Previous experience leading a development team or coordinating technical delivery.
  • Proven mentoring experience and the ability to explain technical decisions clearly.
  • Experience working with outsourced developers, contractors, or distributed teams.
  • The ability to work independently, prioritize competing needs, and make sound decisions with a limited startup budget.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time role with increasing responsibility.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Building products or engineering processes in an early-stage startup.
  • Taking responsibility for several applications or services at the same time.
  • Evaluating outsourced work for correctness, security, maintainability, and operational readiness.
  • Developing AI agents, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, or reliable automation.
  • Operating PostgreSQL and multi-service Docker environments.
  • Establishing deployment standards, monitoring, incident procedures, and practical documentation.
  • Helping junior developers become more effective through structured mentoring.

Growth, Responsibility and CompensationJoining at this stage offers the opportunity to influence how we build software, organize delivery, and develop our engineering team.

Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed scope of responsibility. As your contribution and responsibilities grow alongside the business, we aim to provide substantial salary progression during the first few years.

For a strong contributor, the role can develop into positions such as Technical Lead, Engineering Lead, or Head of Engineering. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. Compensation expectations and progression milestones will be discussed openly during recruitment.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Direct involvement in technical decisions across multiple products and initiatives.
  • The opportunity to build, lead, and mentor a distributed engineering team.
  • Broad ownership across software, AI integration, infrastructure, and delivery.
  • Close collaboration with startup leadership.
  • The potential for significant career and compensation growth as the company develops.

Remote Working ArrangementOur remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to ApplyWe are looking to fill this core engineering role promptly. Applying early gives us the opportunity to discuss how you could help shape our technical direction from the beginning.

Please submit your CV and a short overview covering:

  • A production application you helped deliver and your own frontend and backend contributions.
  • An AI feature or agentic workflow you implemented and how you verified its results.
  • Your Linux, Docker, database, and deployment responsibilities.
  • A team you led or developers you mentored, including the outcomes.
  • Your experience coordinating outsourced development and reviewing external deliverables.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations, taking our startup stage into account.

Public portfolio links and GitHub repositories are welcome. Please do not share confidential customer information or credentials.

data.description:
OVERVIEW

iTech AG is seeking an experienced Senior Developer / Technical Consultant to provide focused implementation and configuration support on a complex ServiceNow engagement for a federal agency customer. Working under the direction of the Lead Developer, this individual will execute platform build tasks, support AI feature configuration and testing, contribute to CMDB and ITSM workstreams, and ensure quality through structured environment promotion and QA activities. The role requires solid ServiceNow fundamentals, strong attention to detail, and the ability to operate semi-independently on assigned deliverables within a structured delivery framework. The successful candidate will be a reliable, detail-oriented contributor who takes ownership of assigned tasks and maintains thorough documentation throughout the engagement lifecycle. This is an excellent opportunity for a mid-level ServiceNow practitioner looking to deepen expertise across AI features, ITSM, and ITOM in a federal delivery environment

RESPOSIBILITIES

  • Support configuration and testing of Now Assist for ITSM features including incident summarization and resolution note generation, following technical guidance from the Lead Developer
  • Assist with generative AI prompt tuning tasks and validate AI outputs against client quality and compliance standards prior to environment promotion
  • Contribute to AI Search setup, document indexing configuration, and Knowledge Base governance rule implementation
  • Execute user acceptance testing scripts for AI-driven capabilities and document results ahead of production promotion
  • Develop and configure ITSM workflows, forms, UI Policies, Client Scripts, and notifications as directed by the Lead Developer
  • Build and maintain Flow Designer automations and service catalog items aligned to client operational requirements
  • Implement CI linkage enforcement on Incident and Change records; support legacy data cleanup and field rationalization activities
  • Document all configuration changes accurately in update sets, change records, and engagement tracking tools
  • Assist with CMDB data quality analysis including identification of orphaned CIs, duplicate records, and misclassified assets
  • Support Discovery scope analysis and data ingestion review for third-party sources as directed
  • Contribute to IRE reconciliation rule review and help document current-state findings for planning and assessment artifacts
  • Execute unit and integration tests across lower environments per established test plans; log defects, track remediation, and re-test fixes prior to controlled production promotion
  • Participate in sprint reviews, daily standups, and technical working sessions with the Lead Developer and client stakeholders
  • Maintain configuration documentation including update set logs, test results, and environment-level change records throughout the engagemen

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Three to five years of hands-on ServiceNow configuration and implementation experience
  • Solid working knowledge of ITSM modules including Incident, Problem, Change, Service Catalog, and Knowledge Management
  • Proficient with Flow Designer, Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, Update Sets, and basic GlideRecord scripting
  • Experience executing structured test plans, writing test cases, and documenting defects in multi-environment ServiceNow deployments
  • Familiarity with Now Assist, AI Search, or generative AI features in ServiceNow; demonstrated willingness to develop hands-on expertise on engagement
  • Working understanding of CMDB structure, CI classes, and basic Discovery concepts
  • Experience working in Agile or structured delivery frameworks with a Lead Developer or Architect providing technical direction
  • Strong written communication skills for configuration documentation, test artifacts, and status reporting

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Second CIS certification in a relevant domain (Customer Service Management, ITOM, or equivalent)
  • Certified Application Developer (CAD)
  • Exposure to federal IT environments or compliance-driven ServiceNow implementations
  • Hands-on experience configuring or testing Now Assist features including incident summarization or AI Search
  • Familiarity with CMDB data quality concepts, IRE configuration, or ServiceNow Discovery
  • Experience contributing to Integration Hub configurations or REST API-based integrations within ServiceNow
  • Performance Analytics or reporting experience including dashboard configuration and indicator setup

EDUCATION

  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent years of experience
  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)
  • Certified Implementation Specialist — IT Service Management (CIS-ITSM)

SECURITY

  • Ability to obtain and maintain public trust
  • Pursuant to government contracts, US Citizenship is required

iTech AG is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristics protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

iTech AG is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Individuals with a disability who would like to request an accommodation for any part of our employment process should email their request to . Please address the subject line as Accommodation Request and include your name, contact information, and a description of your accommodation request.

data.title: Network / Systems Engineer
data.description:
This is a remote position.

We are seeking a hands-onNetwork / Systems Engineerto design, configure, implement, troubleshoot, and validate network and Microsoft 365 infrastructure projects for our clients.

This role is responsible for turning approved technical designs and project scopes into reliable production environments. Projects may include network infrastructure refreshes, firewall and switch deployments, UniFi implementations, wireless deployments, VLAN segmentation, VPN configuration, Microsoft 365 migrations, multifactor authentication, cloud migrations, and infrastructure cutovers.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working both independently and directly with clients and can take ownership of technical implementation from pre-staging through final validation and documentation.

Requirements

Network Engineering
  • Design and implement LAN/WAN infrastructure according to approved project requirements.
  • Configure and deploy next-generation firewalls, managed switches, wireless access points, controllers, VPN solutions, and related network equipment.
  • Configure VLANs, Layer 3 interfaces, DHCP relay, routing, firewall policies, WAN failover, monitoring, and network segmentation.
  • Configure corporate, guest, voice, wireless-management, security, server, and other required network segments.
  • Configure and manage UniFi Network Controller environments and UniFi switching and wireless infrastructure.
  • Configure LACP, VLAN trunks, port profiles, PoE, spanning-tree, loop protection, DHCP trust, and related switching functions.
  • Implement and validate SSL VPN and remote-access solutions.
  • Configure SNMP monitoring and integrate infrastructure into remote-management platforms.
  • Perform wireless deployments, RF configuration, SSID configuration, client isolation, roaming validation, and wireless performance testing.

Microsoft 365 / Cloud Engineering
  • Support Microsoft 365 tenant configuration and migration projects.
  • Configure migration tooling, source/target connections, service accounts, application consent, and identity mappings.
  • Support Exchange Online, OneDrive, SharePoint, Teams, and file-server migration activities.
  • Configure and validate Microsoft 365 domains, DNS records, mail flow, SPF, DKIM, and DMARC.
  • Implement Microsoft 365 Conditional Access and multifactor authentication configurations.
  • Assist with Microsoft Authenticator enrollment and user validation.
  • Perform migration reconciliation, exception analysis, and post-migration validation.

Implementation & Cutover
  • Pre-stage equipment, firmware, configurations, and migration environments before production changes.
  • Perform network and infrastructure cutovers during approved maintenance windows.
  • Gracefully decommission and replace legacy infrastructure.
  • Validate connectivity, routing, authentication, applications, wireless, voice, backups, monitoring, and other in-scope services after implementation.
  • Troubleshoot issues encountered during implementation and determine whether they fall within the approved scope.
  • Support rollback procedures when required.

Documentation
  • Maintain accurate network diagrams, IP inventories, VLAN documentation, switch port maps, wireless information, configuration records, and equipment inventories.
  • Document migration results, exceptions, validation results, and final configurations.
  • Archive relevant legacy configurations and document replaced equipment.
  • Prepare technical handoff information for the support team.

Required Qualifications
  • Demonstrated professional experience in network or systems engineering.
  • Strong understanding of TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, switching, DHCP, DNS, and network troubleshooting.
  • Experience configuring managed network switches and firewalls.
  • Experience with wireless networking and access-point deployments.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues independently.
  • Experience performing production cutovers and maintenance-window work.
  • Strong documentation and technical communication skills.
  • Ability to work directly with clients and communicate technical issues clearly.
  • Ability to follow defined project scopes, implementation plans, and change-control procedures.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience withUbiquiti UniFinetworking equipment and UniFi Network Controller.
  • Experience with Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, and Microsoft Entra.
  • Experience with Conditional Access and MFA.
  • Experience with network monitoring and SNMP.
  • Experience with cloud-to-cloud and file-server migrations.
  • Experience with VPN technologies and WAN failover.
  • Experience with wireless heatmap surveys and RF optimization.
  • Experience supporting low-voltage/network infrastructure deployments.
  • Relevant networking or Microsoft certifications.

data.title: Machine Learning Analyst | 100% Remoto | LATAM
data.description:
Sobre nosotros

Prometeo Talent es una agencia de reclutamiento con presencia en América y Europa. Ayudamos a empresas a encontrar profesionales talentosos en áreas de datos, analytics y negocios.

Actualmente, trabajamos junto a una empresa con sede en Estados Unidos especializada en medir la efectividad del marketing. Su trabajo consiste en ayudar a las organizaciones a entender mejor a sus consumidores, sus hábitos de compra, el desempeño de sus marcas y el comportamiento del mercado a través del análisis de datos.

Estamos buscando un/a Analista de Datos (Machine Learning) para sumarse al equipo global de nuestro cliente.

Esta posición es ideal para personas analíticas, curiosas y orientadas a los datos, que disfruten trabajar con grandes volúmenes de información de consumidores y retail. El rol combina el trabajo técnico con una mirada de negocio: vas a transformar datos transaccionales y de comportamiento en métricas claras que ayuden a tomar decisiones.

Buscamos a alguien con buenos conocimientos de SQL y Python, atención al detalle y facilidad para entender datos y explicar resultados técnicos de forma clara a distintos equipos en inglés.

La posición está abierta a distintos niveles de experiencia, desde recién graduados con una sólida formación cuantitativa hasta profesionales con experiencia que quieran seguir desarrollando sus habilidades técnicas en análisis y manipulación de datos.

¿Qué vas a hacer?

  • Crear, optimizar y ejecutar consultas en SQL para extraer información de bases de datos relacionales y data warehouses en la nube.

  • Desarrollar, ejecutar y validar modelos de Machine Learning, predictivos o estadísticos para identificar patrones de comportamiento de los consumidores y proyectar tendencias.

  • Transformar y agrupar datos transaccionales o de panel para calcular métricas de negocio como penetración de hogares, market share y tendencias de compra.

  • Crear y mantener tablas y vistas de datos organizadas que alimenten reportes recurrentes y dashboards.

  • Revisar resultados, realizar auditorías de datos y validar la lógica utilizada para asegurar la calidad y precisión de la información.

  • Utilizar filtros y lógica condicional para segmentar datos y analizar grupos específicos.

  • Limpiar, procesar y categorizar datos de texto no estructurados o semiestructurados.

  • Convertir estructuras de datos y resultados técnicos en resúmenes claros, bullet points o tablas para equipos y stakeholders de habla inglesa.

Requerimientos

  • Entre 0 y 4 años de experiencia en Data Analysis, Business Analytics o roles similares. También consideramos perfiles junior con cursos relevantes, proyectos personales de datos o experiencia en prácticas, así como profesionales con experiencia trabajando con bases de datos y análisis de negocio.

  • Inglés avanzado, tanto escrito como hablado.

  • Conocimientos básicos a intermedios de SQL, incluyendo JOINs, agregaciones y lógica condicional con CASE WHEN.

  • Experiencia utilizando Python para limpieza, manipulación y procesamiento de datos, con buen manejo de pandas para transformaciones de datos.

  • Familiaridad con librerías como scikit-learn o statsmodels para desarrollar y evaluar modelos predictivos o estadísticos.

  • Experiencia trabajando con datos de texto: limpieza, procesamiento, filtros y búsqueda de patrones dentro de strings.

  • Buen entendimiento de bases de datos relacionales, incluyendo relaciones entre tablas, primary keys, foreign keys y normalización.

  • Título universitario en Business Analytics, Estadística, Matemáticas, Ciencias de la Computación, Economía, Marketing o carreras relacionadas, idealmente con formación en bases de datos o análisis cuantitativo.

Será un plus si tienes

  • Experiencia trabajando con datos de consumidores, retail, paneles o transacciones.

  • Familiaridad con data warehouses en la nube como Snowflake, BigQuery o Redshift.

  • Experiencia o conocimientos en marketing analytics, consumer insights o market measurement.

  • Experiencia creando tablas o vistas de datos que alimenten dashboards y reportes recurrentes.

What do we offer?

🏖️ 10 días de PTO para que puedas desconectarte.

🗓️ Feriados de Estados Unidos.

🌟 100% remoto: trabaja desde donde estés y encuentra el equilibrio que mejor funcione para ti.

🤝 Forma parte de equipos y proyectos internacionales, trabajando con profesionales de distintos países.

🚀 Sigue desarrollando tus conocimientos en SQL, Python y Machine Learning mientras trabajas en proyectos interesantes y de impacto.

data.description:
Associate Director / Director, Data Strategy & Measurement

Location: Remote — this is a remote, work-from-home role, as are all positions at Acceleration Partners. Some travel is required for client meetings, internal meetings, conferences, and industry events.

The Role

The Associate Director / Director, Data Strategy & Measurement is responsible for defining and leading Acceleration Partners' data, analytics and measurement capability. This role sits at the intersection of client strategy, data science, measurement, AI-enabled insights and commercial growth. The Director will work directly with enterprise clients to understand their marketing and business data ecosystem, develop measurement strategies, and help clients make better decisions through data. Internally, the role will partner with Client Services, Strategy, Sales and AI Automation teams to build AP's data capability, improve decision-making, develop new services and products, and raise data literacy across the organization. As a senior leader, the Director will also develop AP's market position as a leading authority on affiliate, influencer and partnership measurement.

Top Responsibilities:

Client Measurement & Data Strategy

• Serve as AP's senior advisor on measurement, analytics and reporting.

• Understand client data ecosystems including affiliate networks, influencer platforms, Google Analytics, CRM systems, customer databases, MMM outputs and business intelligence tools.

• Design measurement frameworks that connect partnership marketing activity to broader business outcomes, spanning attribution, incrementality, customer acquisition and lifetime value.

• Advise clients on how affiliate and influencer activity should be measured alongside paid media, brand marketing and broader customer acquisition strategies.

• Own AP's point of view on measurement, partnering with MMM providers, analytics platforms and measurement vendors to keep AP at the forefront of measurement innovation.

Strategic Consulting & Problem Solving

Data Products & Capability Development • Define and own AP's data and analytics roadmap.

What Success Looks Like:

By 6 Months

The Director has built strong relationships with key enterprise client stakeholders and is actively advising on measurement strategy and programme audits. Qualities of the Ideal Candidate:

Spotify’s mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by giving a million creative artists the opportunity to live off their art and billions of fans the chance to enjoy and be passionate about these creators.

Data is a means to an end, and Spotify extracts value from data through application. The Data Platform Studio helps Spotify win by enabling the application of data in an intuitive and efficient way.

Data Platform is responsible for how data is collected, processed, stored, governed, and made available to the thousands of engineers, data scientists, analysts, and machine learning practitioners who build Spotify’s products. As AI agents increasingly generate code, write data pipelines, and power personalized user experiences, Data Platform sits at the center of one of the most important infrastructure domains at Spotify.

We're looking for a passionate Product Manager to join the team responsible for Spotify’s data catalogue, metadata, and data lineage capabilities. In this role, you'll own the strategy and roadmap for a critical part of Spotify's data ecosystem, helping users discover, understand, trust, and safely use data at scale. You'll work closely with engineers, designers, data scientists, and product teams across Spotify to make working with data faster, safer, and more intuitive.

What You'll Do

  • Develop and own the product strategy and roadmap for Spotify's data catalogue, metadata, and data lineage domain.
  • Diagnose and deeply understand the needs of Spotify's data community, including data engineers, data scientists, analysts, ML engineers, and increasingly AI agents.
  • Identify and prioritize the highest-impact problems to solve, balancing user needs, business priorities, platform requirements, and regulatory considerations.
  • Evaluate and deliver solutions through building, buying, or integrating third-party products and capabilities.
  • Define success metrics and KPIs that measure adoption, value creation, and business impact.
  • Build strong relationships with internal product, engineering, analytics, and data teams to understand workflows, gather feedback, and shape future platform investments.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering, design, and data science partners to deliver high-quality platform experiences.
  • Influence stakeholders across the Data Platform Studio and broader Spotify organization to align around product direction and priorities.
  • Help shape how Spotify approaches metadata, governance, discoverability, lineage, and trust in an increasingly AI-driven world.
  • Stay informed on industry trends across data platforms, developer tools, AI/ML infrastructure, analytics, and data governance.

Who You Are

Greater Good Charities is a 501(c)(3) global nonprofit organization that works to help people, pets, and the planet by mobilizing in response to need and amplifying the good. To date, we have provided over $1B in aid, expertise, and funding in 121 countries in support of this mission.

Position Overview:

The Director of Supply Chain is a high-impact, hands-on operational leader and strategic troubleshooter. Operating at the intersection of supply chain execution, data analytics, and program strategy, this role is built to drive rapid operational optimization across GGC's global distribution engine.

You will lead the end-to-end movement of donated (in-kind) and procured goods, balancing immediate operational pragmatism with long-term systems modernization. Embedded within a data-driven programmatic architecture that prioritizes evidence for decision-making, you will design agile inventory frameworks, establish demand forecasting, and enforce supply chain best practices tailored for non-governmental organizations.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Agile Inventory Management & Demand Planning

  • Design, implement, and maintain responsive demand planning models that seamlessly bridge internal program planning and donor pipelines with global suppliers, downstream partner capacities, and community needs.
  • Establish agile inventory control protocols to ensure real-time visibility, optimize stock rotation, minimize warehousing overhead, and mitigate product expiration risks.
  • Structure and manage a pre-positioned Disaster Response Reserve, ensuring rapid deployment capability during acute emergency responses without disrupting ongoing core distribution.

2. End-to-End Supply Chain Execution (70% US / 30% International)

  • Direct the full operational lifecycle of goods: donor offer matching, multi-modal freight contracting (TL, LTL, Ocean, Air), field receiving, inventory verification, distribution, and financial closeout.
  • US Domestic Logistics (70%): Oversee recipient partner networks and warehouse operations, establishing industry best practices for safety, pest control, receiving, capacity planning, and field training.
  • European & International Operations (30%): Direct cross-border logistics, import/export requirements, and customs compliance for international shipments, ensuring specialized frameworks like the EU Goods program meet regional standards.
  • European Capacity Expansion Strategy: Develop and execute a strategic capacity growth plan to absorb, manage, and scale corporate and in-kind donations across Europe through a robust, sustainable supply chain framework.
  • Own carrier and broker relationships, negotiating competitive rates, monitoring SLAs, and managing detention, damage, and freight claims.

3. Systems Integration, Data Architecture & Decision Intelligence

  • Serve as the operational business owner for GGC’s logistics tech stack (Salesforce, NetSuite ERP, Smartsheet, SharePoint, and WMS), maximizing system efficiency and tool interconnectivity to deliver streamlined procedures, reduced cycle times, and accurate financial reporting.
  • Eliminate manual data re-keying by standardizing data intake forms, partner reporting portals, and digital field submissions, leveraging lightweight, right-sized AI-powered solutions to automate document processing and field data capture.
  • Transform raw supply chain and field data into actionable intelligence, building real-time executive dashboards tracking key operational metrics (e.g., report timeliness, cycle times, accept/decline rates, pledged vs. received accuracy, and net landed impact).

4. Process Troubleshooting & Pragmatic SOP Optimization

  • Act as a pragmatic troubleshooter across the supply chain, identifying bottlenecks, resolving operational friction, and bridging gaps between field realities and formal policy.
  • Develop, consolidate, and enforce unified Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for movement tracking, inventory control, and bill of lading (BOL) submission pathways.
  • Balance practical field solutions with necessary system upgrades, ensuring new workflows remain user-friendly for field partners while adhering to strict institutional controls.

5. Financial Reconciliation & Compliance Governance

  • Partner with Finance to ensure 100% alignment between physical inventory movement, field receipt documentation, and the general ledger.
  • Streamline the financial closeout and reconciliation cycle time for in-kind shipments and handling fee invoices.
  • Maintain IRS-ready documentation (Form 990 / Form 8282 standards), enforce strict no-resale policies, manage recall protocols, and support internal and external financial/programmatic audits.
  • Ensure compliance with U.S. export control and sanctions regulations (EAR/OFAC) for international shipments, including denied-party screening of partners, vendors, and recipients.

6. Partner Capacity Building

  • Establish performance criteria, quality scorecards, and audit frameworks for domestic and international distribution partners, implementing systematic approaches to collect, analyze, and act upon audit findings.
  • Create user-friendly onboarding toolkits, digital training modules, and technical support pathways for field teams, program focal points, and community distribution networks.
  • Recommend corrective action protocols (probation, suspension, or offboarding) when partner compliance or safety standards are compromised.

7. Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Build, mentor, and direct the global logistics team, establishing a clear staffing model and career progression pathways.
  • Serve as a collaborative team player and primary operational liaison between Logistics, Programs, Finance, Operations, and Corporate Relations, translating complex supply chain data into strategic recommendations for C-Suite leadership.

Minimum Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field required (Master’s degree a plus).
  • 10+ years of progressive leadership in global supply chain and logistics management.
  • Professional certification such as APICS/ASCM CSCP or CPIM, ISM CPSM, or Certified Humanitarian Logistician (CHL) strongly preferred.
  • Proven track record as a hands-on "troubleshooter" capable of making swift, practical decisions in fast-paced NGO or humanitarian environments.
  • Strong team-building skills with a highly collaborative approach to cross-departmental work.
  • Demonstrated experience with ERPs (NetSuite), CRMs (Salesforce), and WMS platforms.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Proven ability to bridge everyday operational tools (e.g., spreadsheets, Smartsheet) by embedding them into enterprise systems and AI-assisted workflows to boost efficiency and user adoption.
  • Expertise in US freight and warehousing networks (70%), combined with practical knowledge of international cross-border logistics, customs, and international trade compliance (30%).
  • Solid understanding of inventory valuation, audit readiness, financial reconciliation, and managing donor-restricted goods.
  • High initiative and strategic thinking, with the ability to balance immediate operational field demands with long-term organizational transformation.
  • Commitment to the mission of Greater Good Charities.

Working Environment:

This position is fully remote. The employee is expected to work 40 hours per week from 9 am – 5 pm in their time zone, Monday – Friday. Travel: 30% (includes domestic & international)

Benefits:

Benefits include 13 paid national holidays, sick leave, paid vacation, parental leave, 401K, life insurance, medical, dental, and vision benefits.

Salary: $94,000-126,000

data.description:
WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

YOUR ROLE

You'll build the models that decide which carrier each auto insurance shopper sees on our click wall. The goal is to send every user to the carrier most likely to convert them, so carriers see our traffic convert and raise their bids. You'll also own the buying models behind our media spend, which are held to ROAS.

Carrier conversion data (quotes, policies and acquisition cost) is now coming back to us, and you'll be the one who puts it to work in production. The hard part is the data. Outcomes land weeks or months after the click, many sessions are sparse, the same shoppers come back, and the market drifts. Our bids also decide which users we win, so the model shapes the data it learns from next.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You frame problems directly with the business, find your own data, build and validate the model, and stay with it through deployment and monitoring. An ML engineer works alongside you on the production side. Auto insurance takes most of your time to start, and scope broadens to other verticals over time.

We're remote first, and most of the company works East Coast hours.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

By day 60, you run our insurance marketplace media buying on your own.

By the end of your first year:

  • Click wall serving that matches each user to the right carrier
  • Carrier conversion data running in production models
  • Automated marketplace bidding taken from proof of concept to scale
  • A clear approach for repeat users and sparse sessions
  • Production models that hold up through drift and changing objectives
  • Output the business trusts and uses without rework

MUST HAVE

  • 5+ years of hands-on applied data science with measurable business impact
  • Your models drove paid media decisions: spend, bidding or ad serving. Attribution and reporting alone don't qualify.
  • You built what's on your resume and can explain it down to the loss function and architecture choice, neural network fundamentals included
  • You see how today's bids shape tomorrow's training data, and you've handled late labels, sparse features or drift
  • You own models end to end: you find your own data, build through deployment and monitoring, and bring a point of view
  • Expert Python and SQL

NICE TO HAVES

  • Real ad budget spent in live auctions
  • Large-scale ranking or recommendation systems
  • Explaining tradeoffs to non-technical partners in plain terms
  • Designing for auction feedback loops, selection bias and exploration
  • Hands-on neural network work, such as embeddings of text, creative or user behavior
  • AWS for data science: ECS, S3, Athena, SageMaker
  • CI/CD deployment

Want to accelerate your career? Apply now!

Since day one, we've been committed to having a diverse, inclusive team and culture. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity company. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion.

We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

data.title: Apache Spark Developer
data.description:
Apache Spark Developer – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Apache Spark Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $125,000–$185,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Apache Spark Developer to design, develop, and optimize large-scale distributed data processing applications supporting enterprise analytics, machine learning, real-time reporting, and cloud-based data platforms. This role focuses on building high-performance Spark applications capable of processing billions of records across structured and semi-structured data sources while delivering scalable, reliable, and cost-efficient data pipelines.
You will work closely with data architects, data engineers, cloud platform teams, machine learning engineers, and business intelligence developers to build modern data processing solutions leveraging Apache Spark, cloud-native technologies, and distributed computing frameworks. The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in Spark architecture, distributed systems, performance optimization, and cloud-based big data ecosystems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-performance distributed data processing applications using Apache Spark.
  • Build scalable batch and real-time ETL/ELT pipelines processing large volumes of enterprise data.
  • Develop Spark applications using PySpark, Scala, or Spark SQL for data transformation, aggregation, and analytics.
  • Optimize Spark jobs for memory utilization, partitioning strategies, shuffle performance, and execution efficiency.
  • Process structured, semi-structured, and streaming data from enterprise databases, APIs, Kafka, cloud storage, and data lakes.
  • Develop reusable Spark libraries, data processing frameworks, and metadata-driven ingestion pipelines.
  • Collaborate with cloud engineering teams to deploy Spark workloads on Databricks, EMR, Azure Synapse, or Kubernetes.
  • Implement data quality validation, reconciliation, monitoring, and automated error handling across distributed pipelines.
  • Integrate Spark applications with enterprise data warehouses, lakehouses, and reporting platforms.
  • Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, technical design discussions, and Agile development activities.
  • Troubleshoot production issues involving distributed processing, cluster performance, resource utilization, and data quality.
  • Support cloud migration initiatives by modernizing legacy ETL workloads into Spark-based architectures.


Required Skills

  • Six or more years of professional software or data engineering experience.
  • Four or more years of hands-on Apache Spark development experience in enterprise production environments.
  • Strong proficiency in PySpark, Scala, or Spark SQL for distributed data processing.
  • Deep understanding of Apache Spark architecture including RDDs, DataFrames, Datasets, Catalyst Optimizer, DAG execution, and Tungsten engine.
  • Strong experience with distributed computing concepts including partitioning, shuffling, caching, broadcast joins, and fault tolerance.
  • Advanced SQL skills with databases such as SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, or Teradata.
  • Experience working with Hadoop ecosystem technologies including Hive, HDFS, YARN, and Parquet.
  • Experience processing streaming data using Spark Structured Streaming, Apache Kafka, or Event Hubs.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms including Azure Databricks, AWS EMR, AWS Glue, Azure Synapse Analytics, or Google Dataproc.
  • Experience integrating Spark applications with Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, or Apache Hudi.
  • Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts, dimensional modeling, and data lake architecture.
  • Experience using Git, CI/CD pipelines, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins.
  • Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and Spark performance tuning skills.
  • Experience working in Agile Scrum development environments.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building enterprise Lakehouse architectures using Databricks or Delta Lake.
  • Familiarity with Apache Airflow, Azure Data Factory, AWS Step Functions, or Control-M for workflow orchestration.
  • Experience with machine learning workflows using Spark MLlib, MLflow, or feature engineering pipelines.
  • Knowledge of Kubernetes, Docker, and containerized Spark deployments.
  • Experience implementing Data Quality frameworks using Great Expectations or Deequ.
  • Familiarity with Apache NiFi, Apache Flink, Trino, or Presto.
  • Experience working with cloud object storage including Amazon S3, Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS Gen2), or Google Cloud Storage.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or ARM templates.
  • Experience with enterprise monitoring tools including Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or OpenTelemetry.
  • Cloud certifications in Azure, AWS, Databricks, or Apache Spark-related technologies are highly desirable.


Project Environment
You will be joining a modern data engineering team responsible for building cloud-native big data platforms supporting enterprise analytics, AI, and business intelligence initiatives. Current projects include:

  • Enterprise data lakehouse implementation using Databricks and Delta Lake
  • Real-time streaming analytics processing billions of daily events
  • Large-scale customer analytics and behavioral data platforms
  • Financial risk modeling and fraud detection pipelines
  • Healthcare clinical and operational analytics solutions
  • Cloud migration of legacy Hadoop and ETL workloads
  • Machine learning feature engineering and model training pipelines
  • Enterprise reporting platforms supporting executive dashboards and self-service analytics
  • Distributed data processing infrastructure deployed on Azure and AWS

This is a hands-on engineering role where you will contribute to distributed system architecture, Spark application development, cloud migration, performance optimization, production support, and continuous improvement of enterprise-scale data processing platforms.

data.description:
We are the platform turning browsing into shopping. We connect 200 million shoppers with deals they love while boosting local sales for hundreds of top retailers and brands.

We help consumers save time and money while making smart shopping decisions, and we support retailers and brands in engaging customers from online research to in-store purchases.

In 2024, Shopfully joined forces with the North American company Flipp, creating a global leader in the sector. Together, we reach 400 million households and serve over 1,000 top retailers and brands across 27 markets, including Europe, Canada, the USA, Latin America, and Australia.

Ready to spark your growth with us?

We are the platform turning browsing into shopping. We connect 200 million shoppers with deals they love while boosting local sales for hundreds of top retailers and brands. We help consumers save time and money while making smart shopping decisions, and we support retailers and brands in engaging customers from online research to in-store purchases.

Ready to spark your growth with us?

WHO WE LOOK FOR

We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our Data Analytics team.

In this role, you’ll act as a key partner for Product, Data, and Business teams, leading measurement strategies and analytical initiatives to uncover insights that drive strategic and operational decisions.

You’ll work cross-functionally to transform complex data into clear narratives that demonstrate the value of our products and guide smarter business choices.
If you thrive on solving complex analytical problems, enjoy turning data into impactful stories, and love collaborating across teams, this role is for you!

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Partner with internal stakeholders to identify business questions and translate them into analytical solutions.
  • Translate product requirements into clear data requirements, ensuring data and analytics solutions align with business objectives and product goals.
  • Develop measurement strategies, frameworks, and KPIs to evaluate product and business performance.
  • Design and build dashboards and analytical tools to monitor key initiatives and enable data-driven decision-making.
  • Conduct impact analyses and A/B tests to validate hypotheses and optimize outcomes.
  • Deliver compelling data stories through reports, visualizations, and presentations.
  • Demonstrate the value of Flipp’s products and channels through performance tracking and insight storytelling.
  • Coach and support analysts, fostering best practices in analytical thinking and communication.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 5+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Business Analyst, or Analytics Lead.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail.
  • Strong SQL skills and working knowledge of Python or R for data analysis.
  • Advanced knowledge of data visualization and BI tools (e.g. ThoughtSpot, Looker, Power BI, or Tableau).
  • Familiarity with modern data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, or similar).
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g. LLMs, prompt engineering) to automate and improve analytical workflows.
  • Strong data acumen and the ability to grasp complex data concepts, enabling effective collaboration with technical teams on analytics infrastructure and data pipelines.
  • Solid understanding of statistics and experimentation methodologies.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate data into business narratives.
  • Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and influence decisions through insights.
  • A growth mindset and passion for continuous learning.

At our company, we value diversity and actively encourage it — we believe a variety of perspectives and backgrounds makes us stronger. We focus on potential rather than on having a “perfect” CV. If this role excites you and you believe you could grow into it — even if you don’t tick every single box in the requirements — we’d love to hear from you!

LOCATION

While we have an office in Milan, you can benefit from our flexible hybrid model (full-remote available from Italy), empowering you to work where you're most effective. Shopfully and Flipp, a leading Canadian company, are part of the same group: you’ll be hired in Europe while working directly within Flipp’s organization, in a fast-paced, innovative environment.

Since you’ll be collaborating with colleagues across different time zones, a bit of schedule flexibility will help you stay connected with our amazing teams in Canada!

If you’re excited about joining a dynamic, international team, working on cutting-edge projects and expanding your career globally, we’d love to hear from you!

WHAT YOU WILL FIND AT SHOPFULLY

An opportunity to thrive in a rapidly scaling multinational company

️ A vibrant, informal, and inclusive work environment

We champion autonomy, flexibility, and a hybrid work model, empowering you to own your work

Access to learning opportunities and regular feedback sessions

Enjoy our central, modern offices featuring fresh snacks, coffee (including vegan options!), and ergonomic setups

Engage in meaningful team events: offsites, happy hours, company parties and celebrations that unite us beyond daily tasks

We provide all the necessary equipment for you to work effectively and set up your workspace, wherever you are

Benefit from additional country-specific advantages based on local contracts and practices

WHO WE ARE

We’re a team of 450 people (and counting!), from 30 different nationalities. We’re on a mission to innovate, and we believe the key to that is seeing the world through a variety of perspectives. That’s why building a more diverse team, as well as bringing in even more talent, is so important for us.

TO FEEL AT HOME ️ IN SHOPFULLY YOU NEED

  • Progress Over Perfection: We move forward. Always. In a fast-moving world, speed with purpose beats certainty without action. Momentum matters—not for its own sake, but because it drives results.
  • Clarity Through Transparency: We bring each other along. We work in teams, not silos. Transparency gives context, and context enables action. That means we share decisions early, publish work in progress, and document outcomes so others can learn, move faster, and build better.
  • Learn Loudly: We grow by doing and by daring. Big bets unlock big breakthroughs. But real innovation demands risk, and risk always carries the possibility of failure. That’s not a flaw. It’s the price of ambition.
  • Challenge with Empathy: We speak up, even when it’s hard—because candor shows care, and leads to better outcomes. Listening deeply is how we grow. Disagreeing openly is how we build trust.
  • Always Build Better: We are builders—of products, systems, and ideas. But more than that, we are builders of better. Better has no finish line. It’s a mindset.

If you choose to apply for this specific job position and submit your application, which may include personal data such as your identifying details, contact information, curriculum vitae, cover letter, professional qualifications, and/or employment history, please be informed that your data may be shared with our Affiliates*, including Offerista Group GmbH and Flipp Operations Inc. The aforementioned entities will act as joint controllers for the limited purpose of intra-group sharing related to the evaluation of candidates’ applications. This means that your data may be processed by the Affiliate to assess your application and, if deemed suitable, to contact you regarding potential employment opportunities. However, please note that from the moment an Affiliate initiates direct contact with you and engages in any further processing of your personal data beyond the initial intra-group sharing for evaluation purposes, such Affiliate shall act as an independent data controller. In such cases, the processing of your personal data will be subject to the specific privacy policies that can be found here.

* Affiliates shall mean any entity that directly or indirectly controls, is controlled by or is under common control with ShopFully SpA and its Affiliates’ subsidiaries, meaning any entity which is directly or indirectly controlled by the Affiliates.

How We Support You

Our Total Rewards philosophy is to ensure that you are rewarded for impact, take part in accelerated career growth, thrive with highly flexible benefits, and are empowered to do your best work in a remote-first environment. In alignment with our overall Total Rewards Philosophy, we believe compensation should be fair, clear, consistent, and aligned to growth.
